review_list.author: David Day
review_list.text:
This Japanese-style whisky and cigar lounge truly left a lasting impression. The atmosphere is refined yet welcoming, with a thoughtfully curated selection of premium whiskies and cigars. But what truly elevates the experience is the outstanding service.

Staff members Teresa, Angela, and Mercury went above and beyond with their warmth, knowledge, and attention to detail. Their genuine passion for their craft shines through in every interaction — from personalized whisky recommendations to insightful cigar pairings. They made the entire visit feel not just luxurious, but sincerely memorable.

review_list.author: Ice Lee
review_list.text: 這次聚餐選在酒桃，整體菜色很符合日式餐酒館的定位，也非常適合多人一起用餐。餐點以日式料理為主，口味細膩不厚重，每一道料理都能吃出食材本身的鮮味和質感。前菜和小食類的料理很適合分食，調味清爽又帶有香氣，像是涼拌小菜或醃漬料理，搭配清酒一起享用特別順口。燒烤和熟食的火候掌握得很好，肉質軟嫩、海鮮鮮甜，口感穩定不會過乾或過鹹，非常適合作為聚餐主菜。飯麵類或煮物也有不錯的表現，細膩的擺盤和均衡的調味讓人吃得輕鬆又滿足。整體上菜節奏流暢，不會讓人等太久，也讓用餐過程保持舒適的交流氛圍。清酒的種類豐富，搭配料理能讓味覺層次更完整，增加聚餐的樂趣。用餐後還可以接著唱歌，讓整場聚會從吃飯自然延續，感覺輕鬆又完整，是一次非常愉快的聚餐體驗。

review_list.author: ki yu
review_list.text:
Posino Taipei 是一間可以邊喝酒邊玩🤩遊戲的酒吧^ ^
21 點、百家樂、輪盤會輪流登場，大約每半小時換一次遊戲，氣氛🎉蠻有趣～
消費滿 400 元會送一枚遊戲代幣，可以參與遊戲，
不過如果消費力沒有😂拉高，
代幣數量不多，玩起來會稍微不盡興，
很快就結束回到一般酒吧模式…

餐點選擇不算多，
不過點了豬肋排，個人超愛😋還有蟹肉生菜沙拉都很好吃，
調酒的選擇性相當豐富，整體表現也不錯，是以喝酒🍷為主、順便體驗遊戲氛圍的類型酒吧。
運氣好🍀連續闖了5關，獎品小香檳超可愛🥰，想說見好就收，入手為安😄🫰
有聽說有魔術表演，但我從最熱門的星期六晚上20點到10:30都沒有😌遇到，
有點可惜^ ^

review_list.author: Chuck Wong
review_list.text: Posino is a must come for anyone visiting or trying to have a great night in Taiwan. The drinks are great and the energy is awesome. For every drink bought, you get a chip to play at some fun casino like games to win more drinks. The service is awesome and its always a time!

review_list.author: zoe
review_list.text:
推雞翅 部分酒買二送一
消費滿400有一個籌碼可以上牌桌玩

review_list.author: Koh Kim Huat
review_list.text: Casino style bar is so cool, price list was reasonable. Staff was awesome

review_list.author: 任偉黃
review_list.text: 酒好喝 主持人很美

review_list.author: Carol Smith
review_list.text:
這間是我目前去過最好玩的酒吧！每消費400元會有一枚籌碼，每個整點時會有百家樂/輪盤/21點三種遊戲輪流出，可以拿籌碼去玩贏了可以換酒之類的，採過關制，連贏愈多獎勵愈大，但輸了就歸零這樣，所以可以見好就收~

然後很意外地是酒也超好喝！喝了三杯都讓我覺得順口，最讓我驚艷的是新葡京~很像喝的甜點！唯一小缺點就是酒精濃度沒有很高，喝了幾杯還蠻清醒的😂

禮拜六晚上會有魔術表演，真的被驚艷到超級厲害的~

總體而言會讓我想再繼續跟朋友去玩~

review_list.author: abe chan
review_list.text: 場內氣氛非常之好，有遊戲玩，有酒送，一個不錯的體驗。

review_list.author: 姜太
review_list.text: 玩樂而言還不賴，有百家樂、21點跟輪盤可以玩，消費滿四百元就有一個籌碼，最後的大獎還挺豐富的，趣味性十足。服務也挺親切友善。調酒有很多款是酒精度比較低的，可以先跟服務人員確認。調酒部分都蠻漂亮的，挺適合拍照。入口處很迷幻，走進酒吧一直差點撞到鏡子😂

review_list.author: Liz Otten-Chen
review_list.text: This place is amazing. I cannot recommend it highly enough. We were there on a Saturday night, and not only are the drinks excellent (interesting and well-balanced), the fries were delicious, and the entertainment was delightful. From the games of chance to up-close magic to lap-dancers, this place has all of the best parts of Vegas, imho. 10/10

review_list.author: David Lai
review_list.text:
Great place to just hand with friends. Especially on a Friday night.

The way it works is that you get playing chips upon ordering food and drinks. Then you can join the hosted games that runs periodically through the night. By winning in the games, you can redeem for even more food and drinks. Tons of fun.

Highly recommended.

review_list.author: 周阿弥
review_list.text: 真的很有趣！来台北一定要玩

review_list.author: Gladys Wong
review_list.text: 这里的人都非常热情， 服务人员都很nice， 值得再回来一次！Linda ,服务一流~

review_list.author: TSZ KING Seto
review_list.text: 很好玩，同一班朋友去一流！

review_list.author: 王迎澳
review_list.text: 氛围真的很好！第一次了解这么多游戏规则、很有趣！

bars.addr_zh: No. 12號, Lane 191, Section 3, Chengde Rd, Datong District, Taipei City, Taiwan 103031
bars.addr_en: No. 12號, Lane 191, Section 3, Chengde Rd, Datong District, Taipei City, Taiwan 103031

review_list.author: Kagy Tam
review_list.text:
Visited Le Wine Bar last Sunday which is newly opened.  A very impressive place to visit.  The shop is spacious, comfortable and elegant, just few minutes walk from MRT.
Even though I’m a new learner about wine, they picked the right ones according to my preference.  They have a long wine list and price is reasonable.  Shop lady Monica is very professional and provides excellent service.   It was a very enjoyable evening and I surely will visit again.

review_list.author: Paul Chiu
review_list.text:
One of my favorite wine bars in Taipei with the BEST selection of older vintage Burgundies plus Champagnes. The atmosphere is laid back and feels like you are drinking at a friend's home rather than at a bar lounge.

Prices are reasonable from entry level wines to rare Grand Crus, and the staff is friendly and knowledgeable.  If you sit at the long table, the staff are more than happy to discuss either the technical or emotional aspects of the wine.

review_list.author: Adam Choy
review_list.text: The environment is spacious and decent.  We enjoy very much staying there.  It is a wine bar and isn't a wine bar.  They provide a long list of attractive wines.  They tell you a lot about the wines, and at the same time, they listen to you about your tasting experience. We'll definitely go again.

review_list.author: Kevin Wang
review_list.text:
雖然是勃根地的專業藏酒店，品項有三百多種，但即使對於紅白酒沒有這麼熟悉的客人來說，親切的服務介紹、便利的單杯價格設定（300-500），不會是需要擔心踏入的店家

對於想要近一步品飲的客人來說，這邊專攻勃根地、品項廣又多，可能會從這個去考量

位置有三四桌四人小桌，也有一張十人大長桌，去圓山附近參加活動後，想要優雅小酌一杯，除了附近熱熱鬧鬧的酒吧，較為安靜典雅又平易近人的 Le Wine Bar 也是一個選項

照片附上紅酒單杯，跟冷盤小點的價格跟品項參考，另有一些簡單熱食，eg：水餃，今天沒有特別嘗試，但應該不是重點品項

review_list.author: Preston Fong
review_list.text: Fine selection of wines. Was introduced these few bottles by the owner. The price is priced very well. Atmosphere was very good. Professional owner that explained on the different types of wine. The venue was very clean too. Will definitely come back soon.

review_list.author: 李威伸
review_list.text: Le Wine Bar 對我來說不僅是一個能喝到美味葡萄酒的地方，更是能夠徹底放鬆的場所。每次來訪，Melody 總能根據我們的喜好推薦出合適的酒款。值得一提的是，作為葡萄酒初學者，我第一次參加品飲會時，不僅感受到這裡的氣氛宜人，也完全不必擔心自己的知識不足會影響交流。這裡的每個人都非常熱情，樂於分享他們的經驗，讓人倍感親切。這間葡萄酒專賣店實在是值得一再造訪的好地方。

review_list.author: 李威伸
review_list.text: Le Wine Bar 对我来说不仅是一个能喝到美味葡萄酒的地方，更是能够彻底放松的场所。每次来访，Melody 总能根据我们的喜好推荐出合适的酒款。值得一提的是，作为葡萄酒初学者，我第一次参加品饮会时，不仅感受到这里的气氛宜人，也完全不必担心自己的知识不足会影响交流。这里的每个人都非常热情，乐于分享他们的经验，让人倍感亲切。这间葡萄酒专卖店实在是值得一再造访的好地方。

review_list.author: Lagom Vienna
review_list.text:
每次的到訪
提供的酒都極具水準
環境簡約私密
在圓山站旁鬧中取靜
很適合一個人放鬆好去處

review_list.author: Lagom Vienna
review_list.text:
每次的到访
提供的酒都极具水准
环境简约私密
在圆山站旁闹中取静
很适合一个人放松好去处

review_list.author: Trần Nguyễn Ngọc Thành
review_list.text: Beautiful wine collection at reasonable price. A hidden beauty in Taipei.

review_list.author: Koala Yang
review_list.text: 發現了一間靠近捷運站的Wine bar，從熟知的品牌到小農都有，甚至我來的時候還有一堆老香檳，選品都很不錯，環境乾淨舒服，會繼續再訪。

review_list.author: 呱呱JY
review_list.text: 雖然座位的燈光原本很刺眼，反應後店員及時協助調整，態度也都很好。氣氛讓人很容易放鬆，適合和朋友來小酌，或自己來享受一段舒服的時光

review_list.author: wallenford chen
review_list.text: 很棒的wine bar

review_list.author: 宋宏森
review_list.text: Melody 也很棒

review_list.author: Chiao Wei Chien
review_list.text: 很多好酒可以喝！

review_list.author: DGP
review_list.text:
Feeling Bar 士林店 is an absolute gem for cocktail lovers. The bartenders are skilled, friendly, and clearly passionate about what they do — every drink is beautifully balanced and crafted with care. Whether you order from the menu or ask for a custom cocktail based on your mood, they nail it.

The vibe is relaxed yet stylish, perfect for unwinding after a long day or hanging out with friends. Great music, comfortable seating, and attentive service make the whole experience feel effortless. Easily one of the best cocktail spots in Shilin — highly recommended, and definitely coming back!

review_list.author: Julia
review_list.text: A fantastic place! We are extremely satisfied with our experience. We were offered tastings of all the drinks we were curious about, which helped us choose several cocktails that were absolutely perfect for us. The drinks were excellent, and the seating was very comfortable. The bartenders were friendly and welcoming, and we also had the pleasure of meeting the owner, who shared the concept and the history behind the venue. In addition, the interior design is beautiful and the restrooms were spotless. Highly recommended!

review_list.author: 辰風
review_list.text:
路過這間店時被獨特的裝潢吸引而駐足，沒想到竟發現了這塊都市裡的靜謐綠洲。
​原本想嘗試奶酒，非常感謝店家的貼心引導，主動提供試喝並根據我的喜好給出專業建議，才發現原來清爽口感的調酒更適合我，每一口都讓人驚艷。因為對店家的專業完全信任，連馬卡龍的口味都交由店家決定，事實證明推薦得恰到好處，甜而不膩且極其放鬆。
​內用環境非常優雅，淡雅的香薰氣息取代了煙味，配上音量適中的音樂，讓人一坐下來就不自覺地放鬆了全身。這是一個非常適合與好友共度悠閒時光的角落，未來一定會再找機會帶朋友回訪！
店家目前提供現金及信用卡方式結帳。

review_list.author: 王政中
review_list.text:
很舒服的一個酒吧
老闆人很好可以一直試喝
沒遇過那麼熱情的店家

review_list.author: tam dyki
review_list.text: They offer a wide variety of drinks, and everything tastes great. The staff are kind and welcoming. It’s a perfect place to take a break and relax when you’re tired from walking

review_list.author: X in

栗子奶酒很好喝，也不會膩!!
酒類+50元可以享有100元的甜點 非常超值>

review_list.author: 詹世偉
review_list.text: 非常好喝

review_list.author: Sun Sun
review_list.text:
酒好喝，女生最喜歡，男生也有加價濃度調整（價錢非常超值）
環境舒服，工作人員也非常親切，
喝起來毫無壓力。
推薦推薦☺️

review_list.author: 蘇明慧（Vanessa）
review_list.text:
逛街逛累了，有一個地方可以坐下來喝酒..很棒👍
調酒很適合女生甜甜的，很好喝..或是買一杯邊走邊喝也很舒服！

review_list.author: Sandy Lin

review_list.author: 周詩瑄
review_list.text: Anna人很好很友善，酒很好喝又便宜！！！

review_list.author: 郑甯玮

review_list.author: Ally Webskowski
review_list.text: Great service! Bartender was sweet and attentive to us. Very kind and the cocktails were delicious! 10/10 ✨✨

review_list.author: irene
review_list.text: I’m just passing by and saw they were giving sample to try, I loved the Jasmine Tea and Plum gin 😎 Give it a try! They accept cash and Line pay.

review_list.author: Jack Grothaus
review_list.text: Really good Taiwanese Mojito and Black Tea Lychee Gin. 我太喜欢这些饮料了

bars.addr_en: 110, Taiwan, Taipei City, Xinyi District, 和平東路三段329號

review_list.author: KAORU HSU
review_list.text:
店面明亮让人毫无压力的走进来，店员非常亲切会帮你介绍各种酒的知识也会仔细的分享调酒内容觉得非常喜欢！一个人也能很轻松走进来没负担的店，很开心也很谢谢今天帮我服务的店员们🥳短短一个多小时享受了非常棒的时光，祝福店能长长久久让我有个小天地可以随时过来😆
今天喝完推荐的品项：三振好bitter、飞天全垒打、玛格丽特、sidecar
虽然看起来是全部推荐但所有的风味都很值得尝试，喜欢喝酒的酒友们都请务必来多多尝试！ ！ 🤤

review_list.author: KAORU HSU
review_list.text:
店面明亮讓人毫無壓力的走進來，店員非常親切會幫你介紹各種酒的知識也會仔細的分享調酒內容覺得非常喜歡！一個人也能很輕鬆走進來沒負擔的店，很開心也很謝謝今天幫我服務的店員們🥳短短一個多小時享受了非常棒的時光，祝福店能長長久久讓我有個小天地可以隨時過來😆
今天喝完推薦的品項：三振好bitter、飛天全壘打、瑪格麗特、sidecar
雖然看起來是全部推薦但所有的風味都很值得嚐試，喜歡喝酒的酒友們都請務必來多多嘗試！！🤤

review_list.author: Brian Lee
review_list.text: Very friendly staff and easygoing atmosphere. Staple drinks made well, good for casual hangouts! Would come back to try more Taiwan craft beers

review_list.author: Hou Yanling
review_list.text: 和老公吃完飯散步看到家附近新開的一間酒吧，感覺不像其他酒吧那麼嘈雜，進來體驗一下，沒想到喝到老闆今日特調的酒，很好喝欸！是我愛的茶酒！喝完才想起來拍照，哈哈，總之推薦給大家啦～

review_list.author: Maya Altschuler
review_list.text: Very quiet bar. Great for chatting

review_list.author: Larry Lai
review_list.text: 有調酒老闆和啤酒老闆，老闆愛交朋友。 氣氛輕鬆下班或是假日放鬆好選擇。有食物，口味都不錯😁

review_list.author: 高一心
review_list.text: 環境舒適，老闆和店員都很熱情，招待的特調也很好喝～～～想要再回訪～希望這間店可以一直都在！

review_list.author: 高一心
review_list.text: 环境舒适，老板和店员都很热情，招待的特调也很好喝～～～想要再回访～希望这间店可以一直都在！

review_list.author: 蕭伊伶
review_list.text: 氣氛很好的酒吧，老闆推薦的調酒新加波司令跟百香狗精釀啤酒都很好喝！

review_list.author: Lilly Yang
review_list.text: Some of the best drinks I've ever had!

review_list.text: 好喝有趣!! :D

review_list.author: Liu Jun Shan
review_list.text:
Shout out to Chucky
店員很給力因為我之前在日本喝到了一杯熱的梅酒很難忘，所以他幫我量身定做了一杯熱的梅酒
大推

期待下次能品嚐不一樣的酒品

地點比較隱蔽但店內環境還是蠻舒服的

老劉👍

review_list.author: clara-jane wilkinson
review_list.text: Really good vibe . The bar manager Chuck was very friendly,  and helpful and spoke excellent English. We appreciated this and his friendly demeanor. Comfortable and chilled vibe . Good cocktails and a variety of wines. We enjoyed our time here ans conversation with chuck . Thankyou!

review_list.author: Chase W. Nelson
review_list.text: Wonderful hosts, wonderful drinks, and wonderful quiet vibe on a Sunday night for talking, sharing, thinking creatively. This will be one of my top choices for cocktails and conversation in Taipei. Just lovely people—grateful for the shots, kettle corn, and chocolate!

review_list.author: Ally T
review_list.text:
No menu bar.

Simply provide what alcohol base or ingredient(s) you desire.

All cocktails are delectable and innovative.

Even if you want a common cocktail, they will find ingredients to elevate it to make it even better! Drinks are never repeated.

I’ve been here twice, tried 15ish cocktails (including my hubbys), and each drink was captivating to say the least. Usually going to bars there’s going to be at least  some drinks you might not enjoy, but not here.

For those who don’t like the taste of alcohol, this bar is for you.

For alcoholics, like myself, who surely wants alcohol content v

review_list.author: 廖翊晴
review_list.text:
專業的調酒，用心調配。
就像朋友一樣，放鬆的地方。很溫柔感受的到溫暖。

每口都能夠喝到每個階段的心情，不單單只是品酒，每個body、基底、層次感都是另一個心境。像在杯測咖啡一樣前中後段都有不同香氣、尾韻。

review_list.author: Wilson Wei
review_list.text: 真的 很 好 喝！

review_list.author: Alex Garcia
review_list.text:
Went on a Thursday night and it was a nice vibe. There were people but not too loud. Enjoyed some dumplings, French cheeses, and a tea infused gin tonic.

Staff spoke English and were friendly!

review_list.author: Tomasz Merta
review_list.text: Cozy atmosphere. Outstanding bartender that made drinks suitable to our moods and liking. Live music. Would recommend to anyone

review_list.author: Here Alice
review_list.text:
Chuck 跟Pink人超好 調酒也好喝！
Pink超會煮食物！！！！敲厲害

review_list.author: Tia Yu
review_list.text:
來台北聽娃娃演唱會，剛好住在附近，原本想去的另一間酒吧剛好客滿，剛好搜尋MAP意外發現這間神秘的酒吧！100多則的評論怎麼可能都是五顆星！？還以為是機器人假評論，或是打卡優惠活動😂但再仔細看看每則留言發現並非如此，決定來嘗試看看～又剛好運氣很好現場有位子！

聽著老闆介紹，這是一間無菜單酒吧，每杯調酒都是完全為顧客客製化的！我們總共點了五杯調酒，跟一個起司拼盤，完全沒有踩雷！！喝完是非常舒服放鬆～環境也很舒適，跟朋友暢聊聚會非常適合！

剛好也讓我釋放一些壓力，剛好讓我們台北行點綴，這麼多個剛好，果然是天命酒館，謝謝老闆，謝謝一起來的旅伴

review_list.author: Betty Li
review_list.text: 每杯特调都特别不一样 有很多想法和情感在里面 我点了一杯但是有点不适合我 调酒师立刻给了我们每个人一个 shot 觉得每个人都被照顾到 情绪价值 100%

review_list.text:
太喜歡這個地方了
空間不大但是氣氛好，服務生非常的熱情，空間瀰漫好聞的香氣，推薦約會的各位來

review_list.author: Lam Bui
review_list.text: My friends and I wrapped up a fantastic dinner at Raohe Night Market last Wednesday and spontaneously decided to hit Riff Bar, and it instantly became one of the most memorable and fun nights of my entire Taipei trip! The vibe is absolutely electric, the crowd is great, and the drinks were top-notch. This place truly shines thanks to the incredible live band and the genuinely cool atmosphere. Since it was Open Mic Night, we even had the chance to jump up and play alongside some seriously gifted local musicians, which was an absolute blast and made the evening truly unique for us all. The staff

review_list.author: Hector Moore
review_list.text:
I came here with a friend on our first night in Taiwan, and wow what an evening! The staff are so lovely, we had the best time - it almost felt like we’d been invited into someone’s home, it was that welcoming.

It was a Friday evening when they had an open mic night. We spent the evening singing songs and drinking beers with some wonderful human beings.

If you’re staying in Taipei I’d highly recommend coming here and making some great memories. Riff Bar, I’ll never forget you ❤️🇹🇼

review_list.author: Capybara Drunk
review_list.text:
開醺的夜晚 🍺
這個空間 音場很好 🎶
音樂低頻 會貼著身體走
酒自己順口 滑入喉中
只是坐著 結果就被治癒了

But 總感覺這裡
時光流速異常
時鐘指針 會跑得很快
快到 “欸 這個時間了
那就這樣吧”
回家路上 風有點冷
但也沒差

review_list.author: Huichi Lee
review_list.text: First time customers at this bar. Fantastic staff and atmosphere and we enjoyed ourselves here. Great music and food. I will definitely come back here. Highly recommended!

review_list.author: Dearon Anderson
review_list.text:
This bar offers live music and jamming except for
Sundays. If you are around the area just drop by for a drink. Bar owner is friendly and sociable.

review_list.author: 주혜진
review_list.text:
The bartenders speak English! If you sit at the bar, you can even enjoy some fun drinking games together. If you’re visiting Taipei, this place is a must-visit! Highly recommended.
Cozy atmosphere, friendly bartenders, and a wide variety of cocktails.
They don’t have a big selection of snacks, though.
Located on the second floor of a motorcycle shop.

review_list.author: Kai
review_list.text:
酒保滿厲害，
調酒喝起來很順，
用的酒品質也很不錯，
沒有那種奇怪的劣質酒精味，隔天頭也不會痛。（自己屬於喝酒容易頭痛的類型）
有時候會有Open mic
（老闆說是週三跟週五）
會出現樂手隨機組band，
所以樂風體驗會不太一樣。
可以自己上去唱一下，
或者聽駐店歌手演唱，
或等看看當日有無其他歌手出沒，
就能聽不同風格的Live Show，
抒情、搖滾、民謠都聽得到，主打一個自由隨機的調調XD

總之，
整體氣氛很不賴的一間，
喜歡聽現場的可以來玩。

review_list.author: JE JiN
review_list.text:
從進門開始，佳佳、豹豹、團團的態度就非常親切，會主動關心客人的需求，也不會給人壓力，讓人可以很放鬆地享受整個晚上。對酒款的介紹相當專業，會依照每個人的喜好做推薦，就算是不太懂酒的人也能安心點單。

整體服務過程中能感覺到他們的細心與用心，不只是把酒送上桌而已，而是真的有在留意客人的狀況。環境與氣氛也維持得很好，是那種會讓人想慢慢坐下來聊天、喝酒的地方。

這是一家服務品質很穩定、讓人願意再訪的酒吧，無論是朋友聚會或自己來小酌，都會有不錯的體驗。

review_list.author: 辰翰
review_list.text: 這邊氣氛很好 店員人都很好 特別推薦團子跟佳佳跟豹豹 他們很親切

review_list.author: Patrick Mao
review_list.text: For everybody looking for a fantastic small and cozy bar in Taipei, Bar Mosaic is a hidden gem I'm Zhong Shan. Hidden in the back of a small building complex, the dark ambiance and smooth vaporwave music is a great way to start or end a night of drinking. It's a small place so be sure to make a reservation if possible, but if not, you can still try your luck with a walk in. The bartender (Claid) is extremely professional and artistic with his mixology. Drinks come out perfectly balanced and you can see his skills and dedication put into the craft of bartending. When you see him, and if you hav

review_list.author: Patrick Mao
review_list.text:
对于所有想在台北寻找一家温馨舒适的小酒吧的人来说，Bar Mosaic 绝对是一颗隐藏的宝石，我是钟山。它隐藏在一栋小型建筑群的深处，幽暗的氛围和流畅的蒸汽波音乐是开启或结束一夜畅饮的绝佳方式。酒吧不大，所以如果可能的话一定要提前预订，如果没有，你仍然可以直接进去试试运气。调酒师（Claid）的调酒技艺非常专业，充满艺术感。他调制的饮品完美平衡，你可以看到他精湛的技艺和对调酒的专注。如果你在酒吧遇到他，并且体验愉快，请务必给他小费（在台湾，给小费并不常见，但仍然非常感谢）。

强烈推荐！我还会再来的。

review_list.author: Candy Lee
review_list.text:
新踩點。
喜歡整體⋯店員超貼心詢問你想要的酒感。沒有壓力隨性享受店家調的酒。

review_list.author: Candy Lee
review_list.text:
新踩点。
喜欢整体⋯店员超贴心询问你想要的酒感。没有压力随性享受店家调的酒。

review_list.author: Florencia W
review_list.text:
Doesn't look like a bar from outside, love the very tiny space they offered so it feels homey and cozy, and plus point, very quiet!! 💯 Most bars here in Taipei are nicely decorated and concepted but people who visited the bars are just too noisy and do not know how to enjoy and appreciate that place.

Drinks that I ordered are both very nice, not very much choices but very special. Bartender also very kind.

Overall, I loved it!! ✨

review_list.author: 李杰修
review_list.text: 老闆最近有開調酒相關課程，十分推薦給喜歡喝調酒並且想進一步更加了解調酒的人。四堂課下來至少可以學到16種經典調酒，每堂課都會有兩杯實際自己練習的機會，課程內容很精實，從調酒的類型、六大基酒介紹、正確的技法、器具的選擇到了解一杯成功調酒的必須要素，在這四堂課程中都能學到。課程的最後，也會有驗收成果的小活動，需要在十分鐘內自創出一杯調酒，在這之中老闆也會協助給予意見一起溝通討論，看到自己也能成功做出一杯調酒的時候（如圖所示），真的會有滿滿的感動～

review_list.author: A Y
review_list.text: Teeny cozy bar with max 10 seats. Bartenders were sweet and kind - and the drinks were on point. It’s a bit hard to find, but it’s on the first floor located inside one of the “studios”. It’s not inside the hotel!

review_list.author: Ching Lu
review_list.text:
住家附近的寶藏小店，藏在一個很難找到的小角落裡面的某個小房間，店內只有一個四人座吧檯、一組雙人面牆座位、以及一組約可提供3人座的沙發位，所以建議要來之前先以官方的line@進行訂位，否則很容易沒位置。

這裡只開週五六日，其他日子主要用作調酒課程授課使用，也許也是授課的緣故，bartender對於調酒十分有想法，也很樂於分享及討論，

而酒的風味是最不必多說的，用心、精采、且別緻，值得親自走一趟品味。

review_list.author: Yvonne Chen
review_list.text: Cute little hidden bar! There aren’t a lot of seats but the service is greats. Drinks are very yummy and unique too.

review_list.author: Albert Tien
review_list.text: 店內空間較小，在雨夜前往時正巧店內客人不多，加上店內的風格與氣氛的定位是沈穩的調性，讓人放鬆喝之餘可以好好沉澱一下；主理人對於酒有想法，製作也很細膩不會過度裝飾，每一杯都是用心的作品。建議有意前往的人先在粉專私訊訂位。

review_list.author: Wu Maureen
review_list.text: 很適合三五好友放鬆閒聊的小酒吧 , 酒單 以外， 也可以order 個人喜歡的調酒。很喜歡播放的音樂讓人很舒服。還有bartender 很帥氣喔！一定會再訪。

review_list.author: Ivan Jimenez
review_list.text: This place is a definitely unique spot for those who enjoy cigars and cocktails. My friends and I brought our own cigars and we did not get charged a cork fee, instead we just needed to fulfill their 500ntd minimum payment requirement and that is more than fair. I am extremely for their service, our bartender even started playing the violin for us! 10/10 service and wonderful relaxing vibe. I will absolutely come again.

review_list.author: Patric Lahti
review_list.text: Great place, lovely staff. Owner knows english very well aswell as a few from the staff. Smoking your own cigars is perfectly fine, coming from europe the asian cigar prices are alot higher so if that concerns you, bring your own from home and just enjoy the lovely bar with awesome people, staff and customers alike are very friendly and not afraid to strike up conversation if you come alone.

review_list.text: Nice location and good drinks. We were there on a weekend and the barkeeper said we had to spend 500$ each, which was ok for us. After consuming we wanted to pay, but then another barkeeper said we had to consume 800$ each. If they would've told us the actual price earlier, we wouldn't have gone to this bar.

review_list.author: 許小妞
review_list.text:
想要在夜裡放鬆、找人聊天、玩遊戲、跟朋友一起玩樂、或單獨來但又不想太冷清的人。
有服務人員（可以聊天、玩遊戲、唱歌、飛鏢機）是歡樂又熱鬧的深夜酒吧，很適合想體驗互動、放鬆的人

多數人讚賞氣氛佳、服務很好、餐點與飲料美味～非常推薦👍🏻

review_list.text: Good place to meeting or do some chilling things’s in Taipei!

review_list.author: 李婉淑
review_list.text: 酒宮閣這間酒吧真的是一個讓人放鬆又盡興的好地方！調酒師的手藝精湛，每一杯酒都不只是味覺享受，還充滿了創意與巧思，無論是經典款還是特調，都能讓人驚喜。店內氣氛輕鬆熱鬧，燈光柔和又帶點活潑的節奏感，很適合朋友聚會或小酌放鬆。現場還有歡唱設備，大家可以盡情飆歌，讓夜晚更加歡樂。服務人員態度親切又熱情，時時關心客人的需求，讓人有賓至如歸的感覺。不管是想享受一杯好酒，還是跟朋友盡情歡唱，這裡絕對是值得一再回訪的好選擇。

review_list.author: Dennis Ke
review_list.text: Nice place, great atmosphere

review_list.author: Vicky
review_list.text:
中秋節烤肉快樂！
感謝MK老闆大手筆,準備了各式美食整個氣氛超讚現場的工作人員都很熱情來喝酒就有香噴噴的烤肉可以吃～大家邊烤邊笑，還有辛苦的烤肉英雄們在外面奮戰，太敬業了！

-
🌟 最新活動到 2/28
✔️ 四人以上訂位＋出示本影片 ➜ 送炸雞🍗
✔️ 追蹤店家IG ➜ 一人送一杯茶調酒
（蜜香紅茶玫瑰／烏龍榛果，來幾次送幾次）

在中山區找一家寶藏餐酒館🍸✨晚上想小酌、想吃好料、想聊天拍照都超適合的酒吧餐廳，氣氛輕鬆又有質感，重點是餐點跟酒都很有水準，想揪朋友再回訪了✨

🍳 北非蛋
番茄醬汁香氣超濃，雞蛋半熟超犯規🥹用麵包沾著吃，每一口都有香料的溫暖感，會默默吃光那種✨

🧀 皮埃蒙特的禮物盒
造型可愛到不行🎁托米諾起司香氣超重，配上薄脆派皮和無花果果醬，鹹甜交錯，很幸福✨

🍝 肉醬水管麵
肉醬給得很大方，每一口都超有存在感，醬香濃郁但不死鹹，麵條Q彈有咬勁，吃起來很滿足，會不小心一口接一口✨

🍗 PAGE 炸雞
真的要點‼️外皮酥、裡面超多汁，一咬直接爆汁，完全不乾柴，會忍不住一直夾✨

🍷 秘魯聖木
薰衣草＋木質香氣很有層次
入口是紅酒感，尾韻帶莓果酸甜，溫柔又成熟的那種酒✨

🥭 日本甘酒（伏特加／甘酒／芒果）
酒感很輕，甘酒的米香加芒果甜感，順順喝、完全不嗆，女生會愛✨

🍓 草莓布丁
口感超滑順，入口即化～奶香很濃，加上草莓點綴，甜而不膩，完美收尾✨

🍃 茶櫃
一次喝到8種茶酒和2種點心，伯爵奶酒、金萱、桑葉、文山包種、紅烏龍、洋甘菊、紅茶☕️茶香層次很乾淨，酒感柔順不嗆，入口溫潤、尾韻回甘，越喝越放鬆，很

The place looks like a library, with a special box shaped like a book that holds the spirit bottle and introduction notes. I had a wonderful dining experience. It’s also a great place for gatherings. Highly recommended!

review_list.text: 芋頭奶酒超好喝，有點沙沙的感覺，食物的禮物盒蠻特別的，起司跟脆片搭上無花果果醬，但起司最後有嗆鼻的味道，蛋黃麵的脆培根超級好吃，但感覺醬汁可以再濃郁一點！店員都很親切熱情也蠻有趣健談的，也會訪問顧客餐後感，環境跟音樂都很棒，乾淨又有氛圍，整體來說蠻不錯的！推推

review_list.text:

店員很仔細介紹餐點跟調酒，聽得出來每份餐點和調酒都是精心設計，很多餐點都是店員自己研發，調酒也很不錯，「檜木」和「肖楠木」的酒感比較重，「鳳梨酥」就偏甜，喜歡喝的都可以試試。炸雞跟薯條都很好吃，可惜這次只是來喝酒的，下次再來試試主食類的餐點。

🍸一念甘露
Perilla/grapefruit/gin/plum wine/sugar/orange

作為開場第一杯👍🏻

🍸兒時樂多多
Thai black tea gin/honey/line

喝起來也是神還原檸檬紅茶的感覺

Feb.20.2026 Friday 7:00pm

Score 4.5/5

The food were all cooked nicely and had great flavour. We found a very small hair in the chicken liver. We did not receive any compensation, they just remade the dish. Seems like hair in food is a reoccurring problem looking at past reviews.

Service was great overall, but they did not let us know beforehand that they only accept cash as payment when we made reservation nor when we went in. We almost ran out of cash trying to pay!

Please fix the reoccuring hair issue and tell your customers you only take cash beforehand.
Other than that everything was e

review_list.author: Yunus mm
review_list.text:
在 Chill 嗨嗨酒場 用餐，整體餐點表現不錯，幾乎每一道都能點來試試，炸雞軟骨有口感不油，生牛肉處理乾淨，牛類料理也在水準內，味道算穩，搭酒很合適，週四有不少酒款 $99，也有喝到飽選項，對聚餐來說吸引力高，服務人員反應快，點餐與送餐節奏順，空間適合多人聊天

不過其中一道料理裡吃到頭髮，當下有反映，店家處理算即時，直接更換並道歉，態度到位，但還是會影響用餐感受，另外店內有五星評價可兌換梅酒、啤酒或清酒的活動，所以在參考網路評論時可以自行斟酌判斷來源，整體來說餐點不差，適合朋友聚餐

review_list.author: 七七
review_list.text: 氣氛好，環境佳，服務人員也不錯，以串物來說價位算中等偏高（都各點兩串大家分食）但雞心，雞肝很大塊，整體食物也挺優並有暢飲選項，聚餐蠻合適，有機會會再回訪

review_list.author: Dempsta Yoo
review_list.text: What a gem of a bar and restaurant! We ventured in after reading they have great cocktails, whiskey, and food...and they did not disappoint. Joey the owner and bartender is friendly and knowledgeable with our drink choices. We enjoyed a relaxing meal with excellent nigiri sushi, soba noodles and Taiwanese style pork belly. For drinks we had both their classic cocktails (Manhattan, The Silent Third) and their custom ones (Yueji). Also saw a delicious looking negroni getting put together for our neighbors at the bar. All in all a wonderful experience and would visit again.

review_list.text: 調酒師技術高桿，服務態度親切，每杯酒的口感都非常棒。食物目前只有腰果核桃，但味道品質超讚👍

review_list.author: Kuo Albert
review_list.text:
隔了2年，2025年的某個假日再次回訪，除了吧台幾個座位，座無虛席。
老闆依然很熱忱親切，當天異常忙碌，但有關酒的故事和觀念，真的有求必應。
餐點一樣有水準，廚師依舊一夫當關，喜歡一夜干細緻和水蓮的清脆。
開車不喝酒，下次住台北時再來體驗酒的調性。
----------------------------------------
身處長安東路熱炒一級戰區的餐酒館，著實令人驚豔又美味。
首先先跟該店大廚致意，看似一人控場，卻能在半開放式的廚房用巧手作出一道道美味的料理，無論是刺身到烤物，樣樣令人垂涎，尤其今天吃到烤海鱺下巴，肉之肥厚，伴隨著油脂香氣，真的值得再訪。
服務人員兼Bartender也是此店不可缺的靈魂，他的調酒非常值得一試，就算是不通酒性的小白也可以請他調一杯適合這個夜晚的酌飲。

review_list.author: Amy Low
review_list.text: Ambience was warm with music, not overly rowdy, bartender has a professional yet warm demeanor. The recommended grilled threafin was really good. Nigiri sushi was also well-prepared.

吃得每樣份量都蠻多的，而且都有一定水準～是我跟朋友食量太大，喝完酒開胃又加點😂

review_list.author: M K
review_list.text: This place is a hidden gem! The natural wines are thoughtfully curated, and every glass feels like a new discovery. The atmosphere is warm and welcoming, and the owner’s passion for natural wine really shines through. Highly recommend to anyone who wants to explore unique and authentic flavors.

review_list.author: Chiu
review_list.text:
不管是自然酒的挑選還是小點的菜單都很用心，氛圍更是一個「讓人放鬆聊天的空間」！

自然酒/帕肯特
闆娘推薦給第一次喝自然酒的新手菜單
帶有水果的香氣和甜味，適合和起司拼盤一起搭配剛剛好～

橘酒/幸運
特別的陶甕瓶身，有一種陳年酒香
加入胡椒香料，喝起來是甜而不膩的味道

精選起司生火腿拼盤
四種不同質地和風味的起司，嘗起來有多種層次的變化
加入葡萄更是畫龍點睛之筆，絕妙的佐酒小點

絲綢乳酪
混了蜂蜜醬和堅果，口感多變又好吃!

巴斯克蛋糕
中間保留流心質地，還吃的到起司蛋糕的綿密
重點是「甜度不是很甜」非螞蟻人也都可以安心!

下次還會來再訪❣️

review_list.author: Berny Chung
review_list.text: 氣氛很棒 很適合微醺 白酒跟紅酒種類很多 老闆很用心的介紹 最愛的絲綢乳酪一定要點❤️❤️❤️

review_list.author: Berny Chung
review_list.text: 气氛很棒 很适合微醺 白酒跟红酒种类很多 老板很用心的介绍 最爱的丝绸乳酪一定要点❤️❤️❤️

review_list.author: Chelsea
review_list.text: 第一次喝橘酒就愛上，搭配甜點和起士都很合拍。店裡氣氛舒服，還是寵物友善空間，可以帶毛孩一起來。紅酒、白酒都是自然酒，因為老闆愛喝清酒和啤酒，所以想喝的話也可以詢問，另外不喝酒的人也有無酒精葡萄酒，選擇很多又貼心

review_list.author: Chelsea
review_list.text: 第一次喝橘酒就爱上，搭配甜点和起士都很合拍。店里气氛舒服，还是宠物友善空间，可以带毛孩一起来。红酒、白酒都是自然酒，因为老板爱喝清酒和啤酒，所以想喝的话也可以询问，另外不喝酒的人也有无酒精葡萄酒，选择很多又贴心

review_list.text:
Such a lovely spot to relax with natural wine! 🥰🍷The atmosphere is warm and welcoming, perfect for dating or girls’ night out 😍
The wines are carefully selected and pair beautifully with the small bites. 💞💞💞

review_list.text: A great place to relax and the wine is delicious！！

bars.name: Flow Brewing Beer Taproom 心流釀造
bars.zh: Flow Brewing Beer Taproom 心流釀造
bars.addr_zh: No. 38號, Jiaxing St, Xinyi District, Taipei City, Taiwan 110
bars.addr_en: No. 38號, Jiaxing St, Xinyi District, Taipei City, Taiwan 110

review_list.author: Lana Svitankova
review_list.text: One of the newest and most exciting breweries in Taiwan. Great hoppy beers, but everything is pretty solid. Cozy modern taproom, where you can meet the owner and have a lovely chat. Very ambient and chill place. Would love to have it as a local. 8 taps, a fridge with cans for take away (house beers, guest Taiwanese beers, and imports). Card payment.

review_list.author: DANNY LIN
review_list.text: We got there at 5:15pm on a Sunday afternoon and the place was nice and quiet. Had a casual talk with both staff members over the cold IPAs which were excellent IMO. Chill taproom to hang out for a hour or 2.

review_list.author: Jay A
review_list.text: Really enjoyed ourselves in this brewery! Great selection of beers and a cool interior / atmosphere. We spoke to the owner who had a passionate mission of introducing exciting beers to the people of Taipei. Definitely recommend! Also the lady on the bar with glasses on was really sweet and knowledgeable with her beers - top service from her!

review_list.author: Life's Abroad
review_list.text: Hell of a night out! Came by as part of my craft beer journey through Taipei and ended up staying until close. The brewer and barman has lived an interesting life from his humble beginnings in the U.S and is passionate about his craft. Pretty much worked through the list and all the brews are spot on. Nice chilled vibes, definitely worth a visit.

review_list.author: DANNY LIN
review_list.text: 我们周日下午5点15分到的，地方很安静舒适。我和两位店员一边喝着冰镇IPA啤酒一边闲聊，我觉得这啤酒很棒。是个很适合消磨一两个小时的好去处。

review_list.author: Lana Svitankova
review_list.text: 这是台湾最新最令人兴奋的精酿啤酒厂之一。他们家的啤酒花味浓郁，品质也相当不错。舒适的现代风格品酒室，你可以在那里见到老板，和他愉快地聊聊天。氛围轻松惬意。作为本地酒厂，我非常希望它能成为我的心头好。这里有8个啤酒龙头，还有一个冰箱，里面放着罐装啤酒可以外带（包括自酿啤酒、台湾本地精酿和进口啤酒）。支持刷卡支付。

review_list.author: Brandon Kwong
review_list.text: Great beer with great ambiance. I had the drift, the clarity, and the alpha which were all really good. The IPA I had here are much smoother than most of the IPA's I've had in the US. The service was great as well, the owners weren't here, but the workers who were here were all really helpful and easy to talk to. A great option if you're the area. The location isn't particularly close to any MRT stations, so you will need to walk for a bit.

review_list.author: Jay A
review_list.text: 我们在这家啤酒厂玩得非常开心！啤酒种类丰富，室内装潢和氛围也很酷。我们和老板聊了聊，他满怀热情地致力于向台北人介绍好喝的啤酒。绝对推荐！吧台上那位戴着酒杯的女士非常热情，对啤酒的了解也很全面——她的服务真是一流！

review_list.author: Life's Abroad
review_list.text: 昨晚真是太棒了！我来台北是为了体验精酿啤酒，结果一直待到打烊。酿酒师兼调酒师的人生经历丰富多彩，他出身美国，对酿酒充满热情。我几乎把酒单上的每一款都尝了个遍，每一款都无可挑剔。氛围轻松惬意，绝对值得一去。

review_list.author: YU-CHI LU
review_list.text:
說到台北的精釀啤酒吧，心流一直是我最想來的。
他們有幾管自釀啤酒，也會搭配其他品牌的選項。
自釀的走硬派風格，特別是 IPA 類型，苦韻厚實、個性強烈，完全是我的菜。
環境舒服，不吵鬧，適合專心品一杯，也適合聊天放鬆。
喜歡精釀的人，很推薦來試試。

review_list.author: yu-wen Lee
review_list.text: 我真的不得不要留一個評論😆，第一點要說的是啤酒品質真的是台北數一數二，非常優秀，熱愛精釀啤酒的你絕對不會失望，再來，店裡空間舒服音樂不會太大聲，再來，讓我不得不上來留個評價的原因，店員真的太貼心了😍，不只記得我說的話還會主動幫我加水，和幫我倒我之前有點想喝的啤酒的試喝，我給100分（如果滿分是5分的話），還有他們的logo好可愛哈哈哈哈，像個鯉魚旗🎏，也有呼應到flow 的意思了嗎？

review_list.author: Yingling Chen
review_list.text: 12/31晚上六點多，帶著媽媽和小孩到訪Flow Brewing Taproom心流釀造，大人喝啤酒小孩喝飲料： ）今天我們點了 1. 啟程 2. 巧克力吐司 3. Beach please 啤酒和雞尾酒都很好喝 都是老闆用心自創自釀特調的酒 ： ） 喜歡啤酒🍻和雞尾酒🍹的朋友一定要來嚐嚐！想學英文的朋友 也可以😌來喝喝酒輕鬆說英文喔！

review_list.author: Charles Chen
review_list.text:
啤酒的品質跟風味非常棒、有層次，空間也令人感到舒適
來過一次後，就會想一直再來！

review_list.author: 黃吉裕
review_list.text: 沒什麼好說的，喜愛精釀啤酒的朋友絕對不能錯過這個地方！

review_list.author: W C
review_list.text: 啤酒超棒！！！

review_list.author: 李秀 리슈
review_list.text:
I've collaborated with this company on social media before, but I'm writing this honestly.

During my trip to Taipei, Taiwan, I visited Chen Juo Coffee, where I savored specialty coffees brewed slowly at a consistent temperature using a siphon method, resulting in a distinct and cleanly structured flavor. I chose beans that won an Excellence Award at the ITCE International Tea and Coffee Competition for two consecutive years, and they were just my style.

The butter-baked, crispy-on-the-outside bread paired perfectly with the coffee, and the scallion-grilled chicken drumstick rice bowl, which

review_list.author: 李秀 리슈
review_list.text:
我之前在社交媒体上和这家公司合作过，但这次的体验绝对是发自内心的。

在台北旅行期间，我去了陈觉咖啡，品尝了他们用虹吸壶以恒温慢煮的精品咖啡，口感独特而层次分明。我选择的咖啡豆连续两年荣获ITCE国际茶咖啡大赛卓越奖，正合我意。

黄油烤面包外皮酥脆，与咖啡堪称绝配。我原本没抱太大期望的葱香烤鸡腿饭，却出乎意料地清爽可口。他们还出售自酿啤酒，口感清爽易饮。目前，他们正在销售新年礼盒，内含八个雪糕和八个滴滤咖啡包，是完美的伴手礼。

陈觉咖啡的菜单丰富多样，从以咖啡为主题的甜点、餐点到酒水，应有尽有！保存下来，享受美好的白天或夜晚体验。

✅ 图片中的菜单

ㄴ 310元

[甜点] 奶茶蛋糕

ㄴ 140元

[套餐] 油拌鸡腿饭

ㄴ 310元

[啤酒] 香蕉叶蛋糕

ㄴ 220元

[礼盒] 2026新年礼盒

ㄴ 770元

review_list.author: 韓益群
review_list.text:
I came for a cup of coffee,
but stayed a little longer for the atmosphere.

I asked for a stronger body,
and what I received was a cup that felt balanced and alive —
floral, gentle, and quietly confident.

Some places don’t ask for attention.
They simply let you stay.

review_list.author: Greg G
review_list.text: Nice place with great coffee and beers!

review_list.author: 徐千婷
review_list.text:
氛圍很好，充滿咖啡香，我們五人嘰嘰喳喳聊的都忘了時間～你
服務人員超好，也專業耐心跟我們說明咖啡的特性～
這次僅有喝咖啡聊是非，下次要去吃吃他家的餐點，一定會再造訪～～

review_list.author: 邱家羚Cathy Chiu
review_list.text:
很有質感的咖啡廳，店家自慢的虹吸、特調風味冰美非常出挑、糕點水準之上，更棒的是高齡友善又耐心有禮。

下次再來試試精釀與餐點❤️

review_list.author: Christine Huang
review_list.text: 走錯路意外發現裝飾很美的深夜咖啡廳（還有酒）。帶英國朋友來，很喜歡這裡的紅絲絨蛋糕，虹吸式咖啡好喝！紅烏龍茶是真正的茶葉，可回沖，杯具也很酷，還有附上沙漏，讓外國人覺得很驚喜又有趣。葡萄美式也很好喝，店員說是真的葡萄擠出來的葡萄汁。我們點的咖啡、飲品、甜點都沒有踩雷。 咖啡廳也佈置的很溫馨，下次會再訪！

review_list.author: 최소영
review_list.text: everything good

review_list.author: 谷祖豪
review_list.text: 紅絲絨蛋糕非常好吃！又大又紮實，口感層次也很豐富，咖啡精緻有特色且選擇性很多，不喝咖啡還有提供啤酒，不論你是啤酒掛或咖啡掛都能在這邊放鬆放鬆～

review_list.author: Ronnie Pang
review_list.text: Their coffee blend was pretty good! They also have many flavour profiles to fit anyones taste! Will be back to try the other things.

review_list.text: Had an amazing experience with a flight of Macallan limited editions whiskeys. Knowledgeable and courteous hosts.

review_list.author: 데니얼
review_list.text: 这是我第一次去台湾的威士忌专卖店。总的来说，这家店很干净，提供品鉴，可以刷卡，虽然价格不算便宜，但如果你想找一瓶心仪的威士忌，这里是个不错的选择。不过别指望能找到年份久远或稀有的酒款。他们主要销售各种现产的威士忌和葡萄酒。我这次只是品尝了一瓶百富17年雪莉桶威士忌（800新台币）。

review_list.text: Great selection of bottles and incredible pricing for paid tasting.

review_list.text: 服務介紹的資深經理酒類知識很豐富，除了可以依自身的喜好介紹適合的酒類，也會介紹別家店沒有的紀念酒，進來店裏ㄧ趟收穫滿滿，推薦大家來試試！！

review_list.author: Ramon Martinez
review_list.text:
Tik & Sip Wine Bar in Taipei is an absolute gem. I was recommended some truly amazing wines, all thoughtfully selected and perfectly suited to my taste. What really made the experience special was the conversation with Lin Chuan. Their expert knowledge of wine, paired with a genuine passion and warmth, turned the evening into something memorable rather than just a drink.

The atmosphere is relaxed, welcoming, and perfect for lingering over a glass while having great conversation. This visit easily became one of my favorites in Taipei. Tik & Sip is without question one of my favorite wine bars

review_list.author: 林曉君
review_list.text:

review_list.author: The GOAT
review_list.text:
A hidden gem of an authentic Parisian-themed bar founded by super nice guy owner, Maurice.
Welcoming ambiance where there are fun musical/singing or cultural/language exchange activities on most nights, and where you can enjoy high quality French wine/drink or shisha with a friend or two.
Service is incredibly attentive where the staff would go out of their way to ensure you have a pleasurable time.
Highly highly recommend 10/10

review_list.author: Scott Lam
review_list.text: Great atmosphere, super friendly owner and bartender! The location is superb and the environment is just fantastic! Should definitely check them out, especially their wine selection is top notch!

review_list.author: The GOAT
review_list.text:
这家正宗的巴黎主题酒吧简直是隐藏的宝藏，老板莫里斯人超级好。

酒吧氛围温馨宜人，几乎每晚都有精彩的音乐/歌唱表演或文化/语言交流活动，您可以和一两个朋友一起品尝高品质的法国葡萄酒/饮品或水烟。

服务极其周到，员工会竭尽全力确保您拥有愉快的体验。

强烈推荐，满分10分！

review_list.author: Ryan Tan
review_list.text:
Absolutely LOVED our experience at Pap's Wine Bistro! Located at the corner near Tea Top bubble tea.

What a fantastic spot for a delightful evening in Taipei! The ambiance is cozy and inviting, perfect for enjoying great company and wine! Kudos to Maurice and team for their five star customer service,  excellent food and wine recommendations.

We were impressed by their excellent selection, as you can see from the beautiful bottles we enjoyed – everything from a crisp Sancerre and a delightful Chablis to robust reds like the Château Moulin de la Bridane Saint-Julien and La Rose de Labégorce M

review_list.author: Haru
review_list.text:
第一次来这里，却被这个夜晚深深打动。 🥂
那天的主题是「经典电影之夜」，当 Kris 和 Sabrina 得知我们是因为电影而相遇时，他们特地准备了超级英雄电影Spider man的《Sunflower》🎶——虽然不是 Batman，但旋律响起的瞬间，我们心里都暖了一下，好像被温柔拥抱🫂。

感谢老板贴心的安排🥺，默默帮忙替我在《shadow》时送上我提前准备的玫瑰花和卡片🌹。在音乐中送上这份惊喜，让整个夜晚变得更加难忘。感谢老板推荐的两杯红酒，细腻又顺口，余韵很长，搭配冷肉盘的味道简直完美，不在菜单上的沙威玛也非常美味💘。

气氛也是满分，从灯光、音乐到每个小细节，都让人感受到店家的用心。谢谢这里，让我们在这样的环境里，留下了一段属于我们的美好时光。这不只是一顿晚餐，而是一场充满温度与记忆的体验。这个夜晚，这段时光，就是最美好的礼物。 💖

我会无限回访这间餐酒馆💕💕

review_list.author: Haru
review_list.text:
第一次來這裡，卻被這個夜晚深深打動。🥂
那天的主題是「經典電影之夜」，當 Kris 和 Sabrina 得知我們是因為電影而相遇時，他們特地準備了超級英雄電影Spider man的《Sunflower》🎶——雖然不是 Batman，但旋律響起的瞬間，我們心裡都暖了一下，好像被溫柔擁抱🫂。

感謝老闆貼心的安排🥺，默默幫忙替我在《shadow》時送上我提前準備的玫瑰花和卡片🌹。在音樂中送上這份驚喜，讓整個夜晚變得更加難忘。感謝老闆推薦的兩杯紅酒，細膩又順口，餘韻很長，搭配冷肉盤的味道簡直完美，不在菜單上的沙威瑪也非常美味💘。

氣氛也是滿分，從燈光、音樂到每個小細節，都讓人感受到店家的用心。謝謝這裡，讓我們在這樣的環境裡，留下了一段屬於我們的美好時光。這不只是一頓晚餐，而是一場充滿溫度與記憶的體驗。這個夜晚，這段時光，就是最美好的禮物。💖

我會無限回訪這間餐酒館💕💕

review_list.text:
Had such a nice experience at Pap’s! Good place for a great vibe! a slice of Paris in the middle of 西門町。the warm red walls and bistro style seating really give an escape from the bustling streets below. Many wine selections, good pizza and friendly staff. Owner is very welcoming!!

review_list.author: Osemond Chiao
review_list.text: One of my favorite bars in Taipei,  Liberty Drip & Juke BAR, produces thrilling cocktails as well as refined local cuisine in pursuit of pleasure rather than perfectionism. Its cocktail scene is as dynamic and diverse as the city itself, offering a kaleidoscope of flavours, styles, and atmospheres that cater to every taste and occasion. From the hidden speakeasies tucked away in the city’s historic alleyways to the glamorous rooftop bars boasting panoramic views of the skyline. Whether you’re in search of a classic dry martini, a cutting-edge concoction infused with the latest gastronomic tren

review_list.author: 黃蕾
review_list.text: 服務生弟弟很親切，食物也不錯，現在做的打卡活動很吸引人，酒好看也好喝，不馬虎，義大利麵也不錯，店內裝潢走美式漫畫風，也適合拍照！

review_list.author: 霆
review_list.text:
餐點好吃！酒好喝！店員很親切～～～
還有招待shot好好喝🙌🏻💕

review_list.author: JO LI
review_list.text:
調酒好喝，五星評論送一杯調酒
但位子少又靠近，客人一多就蠻吵的
音樂放得很好聽，店員親切

review_list.author: 薏仁
review_list.text:
月老那支紅吱吱，調酒偏酸，雖然酒感比較不重，但蠻好喝的！還有附上月老符令，很有特色！
芥末佐蘋果豬肉丸，羅勒芥末醬跟番茄的酸甜，還有蘋果醋清爽的尾韻，豬肉丸好吃不膩！
店員人都很好👍，時不時關心口味上合不合口味😁

review_list.author: Curtis
review_list.text: Quite empty when we got here, which was actually nice. Enjoyed the music.

review_list.author: 曹珉瑄
review_list.text: 好喝

review_list.author: Natthanicha Sanongphan
review_list.text:
Cocktail is amazing, giving good taste and strong at the same time. Staff is very welcoming and friendly even though they can’t speak English well. The music playing Chinese hip-hop. Such a vibes!
Overall highly recommend if you want to a quality cocktail with fair price, and vibing like local ppl.

review_list.author: Peichi Yang
review_list.text: 調酒很有創意也好喝、現烤的披薩很好吃、冷氣夠強、空間很舒服，服務人員很親切，時不時過來默默收桌子衛生紙，音樂很對味，終於來到不是用韓樂轟炸的酒吧，很喜歡，以後有機會會再光顧。

review_list.author: 朱嘉瑋
review_list.text: LDJ冰茶

review_list.author: 陳奕呈
review_list.text: 很棒

review_list.author: tc C
review_list.text: 很舒服的酒吧✨

review_list.author: Annie Yu
review_list.text: I think this Long Island is very different if you want to walk for 10 min from the MRT, it’s worth it!

review_list.author: 陳冠全
review_list.text: 松露野菇好吃

review_list.author: Kyota Tanaka
review_list.text: Great drinks and vibes! The staff is all friendly and welcoming. Definitely recommended!

review_list.author: Neal Tailor
review_list.text:
This was my favourite bar stop in Taipei since staying there. Unfortunately I only had a chance to visit this bar once but staff were very friendly and welcoming. I was sitting alone to grab a drink/ night cap before heading to my hotel. This turned into several and sitting out til close. This included drinks on the house from the bartender who was particularly attentive and genuinely great to chat to.

As a tourist I was also looking for recommendations on the city and they told me several stop to check out. I managed to get the shaved ice and mochi from Ningxia which was an amazing suggestio

review_list.author: Krissyy Kraft
review_list.text:
Very nice bar with a fun concept! All the cocktails are well thought out and it’s a great place to hang with friends for a couple of hours! Open til late which is super convenient too!
Friendly staff, great music, clean facilities (especially the bathrooms). Must visit if you’re in the area!!

review_list.author: Aundry Lin
review_list.text: 氣氛不錯，服務很有耐心，調酒還能依個人喜好作微調，整體很滿意會想再訪

review_list.author: Eugene teu
review_list.text: Dope place with English menu. Came on a sun night so unfortunately place was empty but drinks was great.

review_list.author: FireOnApple
review_list.text:
One of my favourite bars in Taipei.
Their cocktails are amazing. If cocktail isn’t your thing, they have an extensive range of gin and whiskey selections.
Staff are extremely friendly and offer educated recommendations for drinks based on your preference. Highly recommended for solo travellers!
Basked in warm lighting, aesthetic of the bar is very modern but quaint.
They serve small bites as well such as dumplings, perfect appetisers to pair with the cocktails.
I’ve been here five days in a row (must mean something)

review_list.author: 張庭瑋
review_list.text: 酒單很有趣，茶酒凍很好吃而且還有附貝里斯很讚，其他調酒算是中規中矩～

review_list.author: Emma
review_list.text:
很棒！！酒單很特別，set的果凍酸酸的很好吃😋環境舒服，廁所乾淨
位子在7-11旁邊的電梯三樓，一開始還找不到🤣

review_list.author: Nicole Anne Victoriano
review_list.text: This is a highly recommended bar in Taipei for tourist! We're from the PH and I came with my friends, we really enjoyed everything, specially the drinks! The staffs are all accomodating and speaks english so well. Definitely coming back🫶🏻 thank you help Taipei!

review_list.author: Chester
review_list.text:
超愛這間店的調酒
去了三次 每杯都有驚喜
覺得很用心
非常喜歡

review_list.author: alfons
review_list.text:
下午就可以開始喝實在太開心了！！！
今天（7/6週日）來遇到的調酒師很好聊（雖然本人表示是I人、不想被透露名字，但酒類知識豐富且對調酒很要求）
調的酒很細緻好喝
我的原則很簡單，調酒師好聊、調的酒好喝我就會留下來
菜單上有寫用餐時間兩小時，但沒有候位的話就沒關係(´▽｀)
這間酒吧我會想回訪👍

review_list.author: 賴晨禾（Brook Lai）
review_list.text: 酒很好喝，每一杯都很有特色

review_list.author: Twiggy Chen
review_list.text: 奶油啤酒好好喝！「哭哭」超酸的百香果基地，好喝但好酸，真的哭哭😆

bars.addr_en: No. 144之24號, Section 1, Zhonghua Rd, Wanhua District, Taipei City, Taiwan 108

review_list.author: Frank Biermann
review_list.text: Little beer bar on the strip perfect for getting out of the rain. We stopped in for a quick drink as we were getting soaked while shopping. There are a few tables and seats semi indoors and a few tables closer to the walkway, all of which are under cover which was awesome. We ordered from the bar and the bartender was super friendly and chill. He told us what was on special and then let us be to hangout and people watch. Overall a great little bar for a quick reset for your feet and then send you back out there for more good eats and travels.

review_list.author: G Whizz
review_list.text: I stopped by The Hole Mini Bar in Taipei for a drink and found it a fun little spot in a very busy area. The bar is small and compact, but that’s part of its charm — it feels lively and well integrated into the surrounding neighbourhood. It’s an easy place to pop in for a quick drink while exploring the area, with a relaxed, casual vibe. Not a destination bar, but a nice stop for a short break and a drink amid the city buzz.

review_list.author: Juan Acevedo
review_list.text:
Hours posted on Google say 2 pm on Sundays however I came at 345pm on a Sunday and the place was closed.

I came on another day when it was open and the bartender is really friendly and the atmosphere is really good. The beer selection is also great.

review_list.author: Sung hyun Hyeong
review_list.text: It was nice a experience. It was really good beer and kindness staff

review_list.author: Cheng Han Chua
review_list.text:
After buying food, they have some high tables to sit and drink the beers ordered. They also have take out service for the beers.

The staff is friendly and have good recommendations.

review_list.author: 要命的小方
review_list.text: 西門町小巷子，有很多種的啤酒可以給你選擇😁

review_list.author: Chiao Joseph
review_list.text:
啤酒和氛圍都棒！
可以購物後享受音樂及酒類。

review_list.author: 納蘭胤德
review_list.text:
西門少有的精釀啤酒吧，位於中華路與峨眉街交口附近，有多樣獨家精釀啤酒，包括：嗨啤5%、長島冰啤、美式IPA、小滿/冬瓜茶啤酒、芒種/芭芒柳水果啤酒、春分/梅子啤酒，以及伏特加、琴酒、威士忌等各式調酒。
店內乾淨整潔，位於步行區街邊，氣氛悠閒，服務人員具備英語能力，能接待外國遊客，消費平實，且可自帶外食。周邊就有台味十足的碳烤店、鹹酥雞店，也有軟性飲料，是在西門町逛街逛累時，暫時歇腳的好去處。
LGBT友善、寵物友善、親子友善，老闆娘外語能力強，親切熱情，喜歡交朋友，就算一個人也能很輕鬆入店消費，或許還能認識新朋友。

review_list.author: Ch ch
review_list.text: 店员非常漂亮，酒很好喝，非常推荐 !!!

review_list.author: Wang Jeff
review_list.text:
可以試喝各種精釀啤酒可嚐過味道後再點最合適的啤酒，若喝不慣精釀，也有一般罐裝啤酒，如台啤、海尼根等。
另還有調酒，只是此次僅路過小聚，期待下次。

review_list.author: Yeon Yoo
review_list.text:
芒种啤酒🍻超级好喝！ 女生必须要尝试🥰
二来 小满啤酒🍻也好喝～ 老板很健谈很友善☺️ 来西门町的可以来尝试哦～ 来自马来西亚🇲🇾游客❤️

review_list.author: 廖婉君
review_list.text: 西門町很棒的地方，點了美式IPA啤酒跟GIN TONIC，還可以帶外食，佛心店家，推薦！

review_list.author: Sharon Ng
review_list.text: 可以在这里享受美食和品酒.. 适合和朋友一起来.. 价钱公道。

review_list.author: Loo Pei Ying
review_list.text: 服务员人很好很好聊也很热情 而且台湾啤酒买五送一很划算哦👍

review_list.author: Hui Ting Ng
review_list.text: 老板服务好 ，地点也很赞，氛围好！

bars.name: VERSBLUE / Coffee and Bar
bars.addr_zh: No. 5號, Lane 10, Chengdu Rd, Wanhua District, Taipei City, Taiwan 108
bars.addr_en: No. 5號, Lane 10, Chengdu Rd, Wanhua District, Taipei City, Taiwan 108

review_list.author: Wayne T
review_list.text: Versblue is a standout spot for creative Taiwanese inspired drinks, especially their coffee and tea based cocktails. The Lemontart was my favorite, bright, smooth, and perfectly balanced, and it really shows how much craft they put into it. Their cocktails are unique and the space is cozy and stylish with a relaxed vibe, and the bartenders are friendly and knowledgeable. A must go to stop for locals and visitors!

review_list.author: Vasu M. Sirivanich
review_list.text:
Versblue Taipei – Café by day, bar by night.
A nice place to escape the hot weather during the day if you’re around The Red House in Ximen. I personally had a really good impression of this place, even though I only stopped by for a short time during the day. It was weekdays & my last day in Taiwan before heading back to Thailand, so the place wasn’t busy at that time. Still, Luke (the owner) was super kind, friendly, and made me feel very welcome. The vibe was really chill and relaxing — such a nice little spot!

review_list.author: 陳彥頭
review_list.text:
二訪：
這一次再訪是喝咖啡，悠閒的午後加上店門口假日市集絡繹來往的人潮，適合搭著咖啡香發呆，一個人也不會覺得無聊或尷尬，店裡的音樂也總是會依照現場狀況做變化，非常舒服享受。

當然要喝杯啤酒或其他種類的調酒也很適合，這裡就是有種魔幻的感覺，讓人一屁股坐下就會想待個一兩小時，後面附上這次拍的環境照片，還有員工們努力研究咖啡製作還有練習拉花的過程，悠閒感滿滿。

一訪：
裝潢新潮的酒吧，音樂也很時髦，位在紅樓旁邊地點非常方便，是西門絕對必須來喝好幾杯杯的地方！！！😍😍😍

review_list.author: Worapong Pattananit
review_list.text: A must-visit if you’re in Taipei! This new gay bar is full of good vibes — it’s a cozy coffee place during the day and transforms into a lively bar at night. The owner is super cute and welcoming. Great drinks, great music, and even better people. Can’t wait to come back!

review_list.author: ken liu
review_list.text:
Newly opened bar/cafe in the red house area. The location is at the main entrance which is great for people watching( and being watched).
The drink is tasty, staff are nice and friendly. The atmosphere is extremely welcoming, a must visit bar when visiting.

review_list.author: Simon Venville
review_list.text: What a great bar on Red House Square!  Super friendly staff and great cocktails!

review_list.author: Ya Mariennn
review_list.text:
西門紅樓旁的新酒吧，氣氛不錯，店員都很可愛很健談~~~酒調的也很不錯，店面小小的，聽說周六有DJ表演唷!!!!

更：二訪，剛好老闆們不在有人代班，但一樣非常親切好聊~~~

review_list.author: S. L
review_list.text:
逛完紅樓想找地方休息
這間就在紅樓左手邊非常近

點了生椰拿鐵跟隱藏菜單燕麥奶酒
生椰拿鐵表現很好！非常滑順濃郁

燕麥奶酒是店員推薦的，沒有在菜單上
咖啡與酒一次滿足！很推薦可以點

店內裝潢很時尚，非常好拍
而且店員也都很好聊天 很輕易的可以融入

review_list.author: Jayce Li
review_list.text:
下午來這邊吃飯剛好經過
試了一下沒想到讓我很驚艷

是台北少數我會回訪的咖啡酒吧
咖啡有水準 調酒也不錯

午夜那提滿特別的 是咖啡也是酒

跟老闆聊天後才知道星期六晚上有DJ來放歌
之後會想再來看看不一樣的氣氛

review_list.author: J C
review_list.text: 找老板jimmy 喝酒。

review_list.author: michelle dreamer
review_list.text: 好有質感的店，超好喝的咖啡！調酒表現絕佳！門口還有DJ音樂實在是太愛！非常喜歡一定還會再來

review_list.author: Wei-Chung Chi
review_list.text: 很chill的咖啡酒吧

review_list.author: Kai Hou
review_list.text:
生椰咖啡好喝
Chill

review_list.text: 美爆的店❤️‍🔥

review_list.text: 好喝的酒好喝的咖啡

bars.name: Galaxy
bars.addr_zh: 108, Taiwan, Taipei City, Wanhua District, Guilin Rd, 160號1樓
bars.addr_en: 108, Taiwan, Taipei City, Wanhua District, Guilin Rd, 160號1樓

review_list.author: Josh Morrison
review_list.text:
So happy to have stumbled upon this bar after going to the night market.

We were fortunate enough to make friends with the owner’s god-sister who helped us order, gave us recommendations, and engaged in wonderful conversation! The owner and his mom went to a nearby convenience store and bought us some snacks to enjoy while we had some cocktails!

The bar is a great spot to start or end your night with lively staff and amazing drinks! Everyone was so welcoming and fun to be around.

Definitely recommend getting a yuzu cocktail!

review_list.author: Alli Zheng
review_list.text: Our group stumbled upon this bar/cafe when we were looking for coffee and was pleasantly surprised that it doubled as a bar. The owner was incredibly welcoming and gave us amazing recommendations on drinks. He went above and beyond making the experience better. The cocktails and shots were sooo delicious and he kept it coming 😂 This spot is an absolute must visit and I highly recommend everyone to stop by not just for coffee but for the experience too!

review_list.author: Karel Beyen
review_list.text: One of my best nights in Taipei was here! Cocktails here are interesting and the ones I had (yoghurt and pineapple) tasted amazing. Bartender was really friendly and helped selecting cocktails. Beer choices are solid. Had a great night out here recommended 👍🏽! Thanks for taking me here Debby 姐姐 ❤️!

review_list.author: MarisAroundtheWorld
review_list.text: Our absolute favorite spot in Taipei! ❤️ The barista is a true artist, crafting coffee and cocktails that are as visually stunning as they are delicious. The Espresso Martini is a must-order—easily the best we’ve ever had. Between the warm, generous hospitality of the owners and getting to meet the adorable bar mascot 🐶💕, we couldn’t help but visit twice during our trip. A total gem!

review_list.author: Raymond D
review_list.text:
I was amazed to find the legendary Spirytus Rektyfikowany (96% rectified spirit) at Galaxy Café Bar! Such a rare and fascinating find — this Polish high-proof spirit isn’t something you usually see at a bar. The staff kindly shared its background and how it’s typically served, which made the experience even more interesting.

The vibe here is relaxed yet stylish, with great music, friendly service, and a creative bar setup. Perfect spot to hang out with friends, try unique drinks, and discover something new.

review_list.author: 陳韻竹
review_list.text: 咖啡好好喝！！

review_list.author: Zhen
review_list.text: 從下午3點開始喝調酒 喝到店家打烊 中間點的調酒 有好幾杯都是店家優惠買一送一 還另外請我們喝現打果汁、檸檬咖啡、梅酒的梅子 真的超親切的服務態度 調酒部分都很好喝 完全不踩雷 大推哦

review_list.author: 鈣阿
review_list.text: 在這邊看T1拿下第六冠，超開心！店內氛圍很好，老闆一直請喝調酒也都很好喝！飲品我都很喜歡，鬆餅很香，今天來觀賽的體驗非常棒！

review_list.author: Lee Minyi
review_list.text: 老闆人非常的好！知道我表姐來台灣玩還招待飲料🥳 飲料很好喝而且很大一杯！

review_list.author: ej
review_list.text: 酒超好喝！

review_list.author: YTING
review_list.text:
飲料鬆餅都很棒～謝謝店家招待的調酒  超好喝的🤩
店家的法鬥超可愛的～乳牛配色太古錐了❤️❤️店家也非常親切也非常健談😆
知道我們想看狗狗還特地推牠過來讓我們看  不枉此行了☺️☺️
下次來台北還要再過來玩👍👍

review_list.author: 林妍霏
review_list.text:
法鬥真的超級可愛，老板娘也超級熱情招待
咖啡也很好喝！

而且老闆還一直請我們喝東西
超級不好意思哈哈哈哈哈

但真的是完美的一家店
推薦愛法鬥的大家來

review_list.author: Justin W
review_list.text: 来台北旅行✈️，很荣幸没有错过这家超级赞的酒吧咖啡。老板人特别nice，用心照顾每一位顾客，咖啡☕️和鸡尾酒🍹很好喝，店家一点没有在吝惜用料哟！妥妥的5星好评 强力推荐！！

review_list.author: Luis F. Borges
review_list.text: Great atmosphere for a 下午茶，咖啡 😁

review_list.author: Yi
review_list.text: 奶酥厚片好吃😋

review_list.author: Christopher Johnson

我原来不太爱喝酒的人。
我来台湾玩儿的时候爱喝啤酒的台湾朋友（酒鬼）推荐给让我喝喝看了。然后才发现了台湾有这么特别的啤酒，叫“24节气啤酒”我觉得满有特色的啤酒。这么好喝，有特色的啤酒在韩国只是我一个人知道的感觉，所以我很痛苦，因为很多外国人来台湾玩儿的时候都买噶瑪蘭whisky回去。今天我特地来这边的原因是想了解一下24节气的啤酒，然后想给大家看看说明一下“台湾有这么特色的啤酒”。我没想到你们这么亲切又仔细地给我讲解关于24节气啤酒。谢谢您们给我提供这么好的机会和体验！我会好好整理一下24节气啤酒，努力让更多的韩国人知道！

review_list.author: Fish Yu
review_list.text:
從在地社團得知原本的49會館已經換成另一間茶酒吧，身為在地酒鬼當然要去嚐鮮。一入內就有股脂粉味撲鼻而來，後來Bartender解釋為了去除前一間店遺留的濃厚菸味，還花了一番功夫。目前的酉茶提案是一間空間不小、裝潢簡約雅緻的酒吧，主打的茶類調酒與小食也挺不錯，希望可以開久一點。

----------
【辣起司薯條】
薯條很酥脆，辣起司粉很夠味但沒什麼辣味，整體而言是挺不錯的薯條。

【枯山水藝術家】
表層是以松針與松子打成的泡沫，質地細緻，酒體的柚子風味酸甜調除了茶感外，還帶有松香，酒感中等。

【瘋狂宿醉俱樂部】
酸甜調有點重，但氣泡口感與茶感，讓這杯酒的風味不至於太重，酒感輕。

【下班飲酒學】
表層是質地細緻的花生奶蓋與烏龍茶粉，整體是帶點花生風味與輕微酒感的氣泡水，酒感很輕，我還挺喜歡。

【憂愁煙火氣】
主體是茶梅的重酸甜調，又帶點木質調與茶感，酒感中等略重。

review_list.author: Wico Wen
review_list.text:
木柵人週末想喝一杯,
去市區要回來實在太麻煩,
因此逛到這家在附近的小酒館.

主打在地差異化
貓空茶/梅酒/奶酒/威士忌

招牌是 "鐵觀音梅酒"
(茶是老闆去貓空與茶農合作自己煮,
據說很搞剛)

1. 鐵觀音梅酒
入口當下 "清爽, 和諧"
初始梅酒風味 + 末段茶香

2. 鐵觀音威士忌梅酒
入口當下混合了 "泥煤/梅子/些微的茶香"
"非常" 有層次, 喜歡威士忌的推薦試試

一杯 250~300

---

店裡的氣氛很放鬆, 老闆很好聊/好客.

原本想說一個人怕無聊
帶本書以備不時之需
結果根本沒看幾頁 🤣

整體推薦

review_list.author: Derek J. Foley
review_list.text: Cats? Cocktails? Whiskey? Food? What isn't to love? Super cute and cozy bistro/bar with amazing staff and drinks. My 中文 is terrible but they're very helpful and welcoming. Drinks are excellent and innovative, and they have a variety of liquor. Did I mention the cats? They rescue and adopt out cats, and you can always play with them even if you can't adopt. I've met so many friends here, I love 安靜小酒館 aka Quiet Bistro!

review_list.author: lee yunshen
review_list.text: The cocktails and special treats were both delicious! The atmosphere, service, and food were all excellent. And thank you for the lovely care and love shown to the cats – a truly wonderful place! 🥺

review_list.author: Li-Hsien Yen
review_list.text:
Innovative craft cocktails, chill atmosphere, great food, and CATS?! What more could you want? :)

The owner of this bar will take in special needs cats and kittens, which you can play and interact with. If she feels that the person is a good fit to take care of them, they can adopt the kitty on the spot! But in the meantime, you can play with them so long as you're respectful to the animals and the location :)

Food and drinks here are nothing short of amazing, with some interesting twists to classics if you want to try a new spin on something familiar.

I'm so happy that this bar is thriving

💯💢💥
I remained totally speechless.
This hidden bar was an absolute revelation.
Quality of ingredients, many of them are homemade, and combinations are absolutely delicious and perfectly balanced.
So many original cocktails I couldn't believe even possible to make.
My only regret is not having tasted more drinks, but after three of them, I was getting a bit tipsy 😅.

review_list.author: Erica Hwang
review_list.text: Came here on our last night in Taipei and it was the best way to finish our visit! Delicious and unique drinks inspired by regional ingredients in Taiwan that worked together amazingly. My favorite part was how the garnishes changed up the drinks and weren’t there simply for show. The owners were friendly and fun to spend time with. We will definitely be back on our next visit to Banqiao.

review_list.author: Clovia Wu
review_list.text:
環境舒適放鬆但不失主理人個性展現的細節。

感謝當晚親切的招待，名為《嘉義》、《蘇阿姨pizza屋》的調酒，和幾杯茶酒shot都很好喝！酒感和風味平衡，另外也謝謝剝皮辣椒雞湯，讓空腹開喝的人安心也滿足！板橋愈來愈多好選擇之一，會找機會再訪的！ ：）

還有大家可以一起喝的手提包調酒，忘記名稱了，只記得松露及蜂蜜的味道有層次很順。
可帶外食叫外送，店員都很用心服務！

review_list.author: Le Na
review_list.text:

review_list.text:
其實大概一年多前我就知道這家酒吧，直到今日才有機會與室友一同前往飲酒。

我平常是對酒稍微挑剔的人，大部分都是喝經典調酒（馬丁尼／曼哈頓／尼格羅尼），基底酒質需要很講究。因此店家的酒水可以喝特調，味道就是咩酒的味道，要喝醉可以請闆娘特調，酒精加重會加錢；八天德特調也不錯，喝得出小心思跟堅持。如果喜歡喝經典調酒，就不要為難店家了，喝開心好喝比較重要。

在這裡可以開心的唱歌喝酒，
歌曲還比KTV多，又多又新，點一杯酒，就可以唱到天荒地老，何樂而不為？（別真的只唱歌不喝酒，做人要上道，人家店家也要生存）

一個充滿自由跟各種故事的可愛小店家，躲藏在三和夜市裡。

review_list.author: Mr potatoe Mo
review_list.text:
嘿，刚刚在台北的Lived Bar度过了一次有趣的密室逃脱体验——就像和福尔摩斯玩捉迷藏，而且这一次他们表现得相当棒！演员们的表演让整个体验比平常的夜晚更引人入胜。

故事情节是一部巧妙融合了间谍惊悚、喜剧和一点点'等等，刚刚到底发生了什么'的元素。我几乎和组装宜家家具一样困惑。真心感谢那些幕后的故事编排者，他们真的知道如何让你始终保持紧张感。

现在，我们来聊聊密室逃脱前后的小饮料——确实是个体贴的点子。就好像他们知道我们需要一点点提神——真是玩得漂亮！那逃脱后的一口饮料感觉就像是小小的胜利，征服了一座心理小山。

然后，关于那出乎意料的时刻——是的，有一刻我被吓到了，以至于我可能意外地为整个身临其境的经历添加了一些'个人色彩'。想象一下：恐惧和惊讶的混合，导致了一点小小的意外。他们的表演太逼真了，我几乎没注意到，而且令我惊讶的是，他们甚至负责了清理。

总的来说，Lived Bar提供了一次真正身临其境的体验；他们轻松赢得了我六星的评价！我正在考虑拉更多朋友参加这次逃脱比赛——谁知道，他们可能会创造出自己的难忘时刻。为Lived Bar欢呼，这里的冒险是真实的，而且有时候惊喜也是真实的！

review_list.text:
如果要選我心中的 No.1 密室主題，那一定是《利維德酒吧》。
這不只是一場逃脫遊戲，而是一場關於「人」與「故事」的深度體驗。

場景設計精緻到像真的走進了一間高級酒吧，每一個角落都有巧思，每一處細節都藏著驚喜。劇情的懸疑與反轉更是讓人沉浸其中，不只是解謎，而是在慢慢拼湊出每個角色的心事與秘密。

最打動我的是，這裡不只是破案或逃脫，而是每個人都能在其中找到一段屬於自己的投射與共鳴。你會發現，每個來到這間酒吧的人，其實都在分享某一種，沒說出口的情感。

而我最喜歡的酒保——是溫柔又有磁場的 Sunny！他的引導節奏拿捏得剛剛好，像在閱讀一本緩慢鋪陳、最後高潮迭起的小說，讓人流連忘返。

《利維德酒吧》，我願意一直回訪，因為每次來，都像重新認識一次自己。

review_list.author: Liza Huang
review_list.text:
困擾我們一個多月的酒櫃 "會經常突發連續警示響音", 在歷經 5 家公司的被當人球, 卻找不到原本賣家的維修人員, 上府來之後, 2025.10.03 的 10:50am, 終於, 原本賣家 "祥銘貿易" 的 Ms. 李, 替我們尋找的專修各種品牌酒櫃之 D'Life 低調生活, 所派出的 Mr. 吳, 抵達了我們家.

看不出年齡已過 40 的 Mr. 吳, 以他 20+ 年之酒櫃維修經驗 & 專業技術, 加上臉上一直掛著的親切笑容 (還有不少的汗珠), 在將近 3 小時裡, 不但將我們的酒櫃維修好, 還把舊的 Eurocave 酒櫃, 也做了保養, 甚至於, 還很有耐心的, 重排了 2 台酒櫃裡面的酒瓶置放位置 (以免櫃內的層架, 會因為負荷不正, 而損害酒櫃的層架).

因此, 對於 D'Life & Mr. 吳, ....我怎麽可以, 不給 5 顆星的好評呢?  My 2 thumbs are UP!

review_list.author: Liza Huang

看不出年龄已过 40 的 Mr. 吴, 以他 20+ 年之酒柜维修经验 & 专业技术, 加上脸上一直挂着的亲切笑容 (还有不少的汗珠), 在将近 3 小时里, 不但将我们的酒柜维修好, 还把旧的 Eurocave 酒柜, 也做了保养, 甚至于, 还很有耐心的, 重排了 2 台酒柜里面的酒瓶置放位置 (以免柜内的层架, 会因为负荷不正, 而损害酒柜的层架).

因此, 对于 D'Life & Mr. 吴, ....我怎么可以, 不给 5 颗星的好评呢?  My 2 thumbs are UP!

把拔立刻詢問一位服務員是否有拖把，對方的回答有些含糊，或許是溝通不良。為了避免其他客人踩到，把拔選擇原地等馬麻回來後，自己去廁所找拖把與水桶出來清理。這部分我們都已盡力處理，自己負責清理也沒有問題😇
快清理完的時候，另一位背著平板的服務生才走過來，詢問是不是狗狗尿尿，接著帶有埋怨地說不要讓她在這邊走，因為會嚇到店裡他的貓等等。然後把拖把接過去，不問實際情況把整片地面又重新拖了一遍(包含其他乾淨的部分)。這樣的處理方式，實在讓我們感到狼狽難堪又很錯愕，也讓人沒有再次回訪的意願……

review_list.author: E. L.
review_list.text:
33025 酒吧：靈魂與單寧的深夜對談
在城市喧囂的縫隙中，33025 Wine Bar 像是一張溫柔的爵士黑膠唱片，緩緩旋轉出迷人的音頻。這裡不僅是一間酒吧，更是主理人——資深電台主持人陳安 (Ann Chen) 的情感延伸。作為《陳安的爵士小酒館》節目的創作者，她將電波中的那份知性與對生活的浪漫，具象化為實體的空間，讓每一位推門而入的賓客，都能從感官的流動中找到共鳴。
這裡的酒單如同爵士樂的即興演奏，既有經典產區的沉穩，也不乏自然酒款的驚喜。陳安深知每一款酒背後的故事，正如她對每一段音軌的挑剔與熱愛。當夕陽沉落，溫暖的燈光亮起，店內播放著精心挑選的爵士樂，酒杯交錯的清脆聲響與薩克斯風的低吟交織成最動人的背景音。無論您是尋求孤獨沈思的片刻，還是渴望一場靈魂深處的對談，33025 Wine Bar 都能提供一份難得的靜謐。在這裡，酒是媒介，樂是橋樑，而陳安的品味則是這場午夜夢境的總指揮。
33025 Wine Bar: A Midnight Dialogue of Soul and Tannins

review_list.text:
在這裡上了an.oaktree一棵橡樹 的晶礦編織課～ 老師人很好、教學細心，晶礦編織的成品也很漂亮！很推薦！
巢穴的空間很美、讓人感到放鬆，這次沒機會參與到巢穴本身的活動（導覽？），以後會想來參與他們辦的活動或市集～～
（btw 狗狗很可愛…🥹）

review_list.author: 何BELLA
review_list.text:
第一次到訪需參與完一個小時的新手導覽，可以了解巢穴的發展脈絡以及理念。

對我來說這是一個充滿流動的地方，歡迎大家各種想法及知識的交流；在巢穴中的討論與分享，得到的啟發或是共鳴都非常寶貴；疲憊的時候聽聽眾人的故事也很棒。

對於人文科學、靈性生活或是藝術等有興趣的人或許都會在這裡有屬於自己的收穫。

review_list.author: Cratos Murge
review_list.text: This is so far the most interesting, beautiful and friendly place I’ve found so far in Taipei. This project’s purpose is simply amazing. I love the space, the people, the environment! I really felt at home. If you are visiting Taipei and you like art, friends and sharing, THIS is your place!

review_list.author: Nicolas Pang
review_list.text:
Good time, pet-friendly, good service and comfortable atmosphere.

It is nice to see the owners’ attempt on renovating a historical building, but with just enough renovation to preserve the original characteristics of the building.

The afternoon tea session we’ve had today was full of surprises, the good kinds. From the furniture to the botanical portion of the location, all the way to the building itself - all have either historical significance or certain amount of trivial facts behind each item.

review_list.author: Sujoy Guha
review_list.text:
A hidden Taipei gem. Had a wonderful evening of conversations, poetry, and music with new found bohemian friends. The hosts are a lovely couple and are so very generous with their hospitality.
Had a delicious vegetarian meal made from scratch by the hosts(they offer non vegetarian dinners too). The Lair is an entrepreneurial endeavor to create a community of like-minded individuals who believe in "Community". Will visit them again soon.

review_list.author: Kerr
review_list.text:
這是一件座落在瑠公圳旁的藝術作品
他尚未完成，但十分迷人
在這個有機的空間裡，思想、藝術、音樂、茶香、咖啡香都會伸出他們的手，等你與他們產生連結

review_list.author: Yuki Su (YUKI 的食味人生)
review_list.text:
第一次到訪，務必8點，要聽聽新手導覽。
你會發現，這裡不僅是藝術沙龍空間，
更是一個讓故事、想法、靈感與信仰彼此 共存 的場域。

這裡
是我靈感 思想的家
當然
還有好吃的食物 咖啡 跟 歡笑聲

review_list.author: Maria Julia Silveira Castro
review_list.text: If you have the chance, come!!! This is the place that my fondest memories of Taiwan took place. The Lair is a wonderful place I had the chance to visit several times. The conversations, the people, and the love are just simply unique! We drink, have fun, and the owners go above and beyond to make our experience awesome.

review_list.author: Vicky
review_list.text: You will definitely feel a sense of belonging once you step in with an open mind. High recommend to the lost souls~ New friends will be here to embrace you.

review_list.author: MH J
review_list.text: 適合所有想暫時逃離臺北這個大城市緊迫節奏需要呼吸的人來，這裡的時區跟外面是不一樣的，思想更是一場流動的饗宴。

review_list.author: Ding-Sen Cheng
review_list.text: The overall environment is very helpful. It can be used as a personal space for rest, recording, and live streaming, or as a gathering space for many friends, about 15 people. It can also be used for activities, sports, yoga, or for about 30 people. It can be used for business registration as an office space, offering diverse business applications. There are also classes that can be rented out for you to learn more. I recommend you come and check it out.

review_list.author: sz sz Lian
review_list.text: Great venue, located in the basement, with restrooms and two entrances. Shoes must be changed upon entry. Free Wi-Fi is available. Clean and conveniently located; a bus stop is nearby, about a 2-minute walk away. It's also about an 8-minute walk to Tamsui MRT station.

review_list.author: sz sz Lian
review_list.text:

review_list.author: Ding-Sen Cheng

will visit again.

review_list.author: Carlos
review_list.text:
酒是好喝的
環境偏吵雜聊天要很大聲
但地下室的服務生感覺很看人來服務
對某些客人很熱情態度很好
但對我們非常冷漠且不關心
感覺對每一位旅客服務態度很不一
請問這是什麼雙重標準？？？

review_list.author: Rashmitha Rao
review_list.text: Definitely recommend this place either with friends or for a date. It’s very versatile, lovely set of cocktails and amazing ambience. The best part is all the ingredients that go in are made in house which adds to the charm and the taste of the cocktail and the bartenders are passionate about the drinks they are making. I highly recommend the cocktail Dreamboat which has Osmanthus Gin and other floral notes to anyone who likes a floral drink.

review_list.author: George Chiao
review_list.text: Delicious juicy burgers and fresh microbrew. I love their IPA. It’s a great place to hangout with friends while having great universal comforting food, burgers, fries and beers. Definitely will come again whenever I miss a good burger and craft beer. Too bad I didn’t get a chance to take a picture of my burger. I guess I can’t resist the look of my burger and dug right in. Oh, their cocktails are pretty nice as well.

review_list.author: EM
review_list.text:
What a great and cool place!
The beer is delicious and cold. The food ia the highlight of the show. American burgers and snacks with great quality. The only issue is that they do not offer beers smaller than 600ml, which is a big miss. Barman Alex runs the show in the bar downstairs.

review_list.author: Zoe Scott
review_list.text:
Really fun bar. They have a decent size space upstairs in the main floor, where you see the brews and large tables.

Downstairs is a super cool bar with some very unique drinks! We opted for the bottle of house red wine, but we watched the bar tender make some really cool drinks.

Dark lighting, great place to hang out. Worth stopping in for a drink.

review_list.author: SHANJUNG WU
review_list.text: 和朋友週五續攤喝一杯，蠻喜歡店內的氣氛的，B1與1樓的氣氛不太一樣，當日是到B1，裡面空間很大，很快就點到酒，不過當日和我們介紹酒的服務員不是很熱情，因為趕車所以速速喝一杯酒喔離開了，有機會會再來！

review_list.text:
氣氛超好！ 價錢不貴 酒好喝
下次會想要再來很喜歡
Bartender也很可愛！

review_list.author: YS
review_list.text: Nothing spectacular about the environment but I must say that the cocktails are great! Love the presentation of my drink and the taste of it too. Look forward to revisit and try the other drinks in the menu!

review_list.author: Mitch Liao
review_list.text:
氣氛非常好，室內設計頗具新意
bartenders男帥女美，你不說話也不會跟你尬聊
當天剛好是bartender之夜，有幸點到知名調酒師的特調🍸🍹

另外還有本家固有的紅寶石、粉紅佳人，都是愛的微酸口感，雖然品酒年資很低，但喜歡酸的朋友還是推薦大家喔！

食物：
因為前一站跟朋友已經吃很多了、這次沒有點
看別桌在喝有點可惜，但凡事常有下一次
下一次再來再雪恥... 我是說，吃東西配美酒☺️✨

review_list.author: SAIVE Liu
review_list.text:
身為一個平常對調酒價格比較敏感的人，這次來到台北老牌酒吧 Intention 覺得蠻值得的。這家店最大的特色就是「沒有菜單」，你可以根據自己的心情、喜歡的基酒基地、酒精濃度或是酸甜比例直接跟調酒師溝通。我個人覺得這種互動非常有趣，調酒師會根據你的形容詞調配出一杯專屬的酒。
重點是，調酒師會先跟你溝通好大約的價格，這點讓消費者感到很踏實，不會有被當盤子的感覺。我喝的那杯味道平衡得很好，酒精感厚實但不刺鼻，非常推薦。雖然單杯價格在 400-600 元左右不便宜，但考量到客製化程度與舒適的氛圍，這裡絕對是跟朋友小酌談心的首選。

As someone who finds cocktail prices in Taiwan a bit steep, my experience at Intention was genuinely impressive. This legendary Taipei bar features a "No Menu" concept. Instead of picking from a list, you describe your preferences—base spirit, flavor profile (sweet/sour), and alcohol strength—directly to the bartender. I found this i

review_list.author: Chloé Chong
review_list.text:
Franchement, ce restaurant est une énorme déception. En entrant, on se laisse berner par la déco et l’ambiance qui sont vraiment sympas… mais alors le service, c’est une catastrophe.
Nous avons passé commande à 21h20, et le premier plat n’est arrivé qu’à 21h50. Le pire, c’est que la dernière personne de la table n’a été servie qu’à 22h40. C’est juste inadmissible.
En plus de ça, les portions étaient ridiculement petites, impossible d’être rassasié. Les desserts étaient aussi mauvais que chers : un brownie dur comme une brique, un tiramisu glacé au milieu, bref, immangeables.
Pour couronner le

review_list.author: Divya A
review_list.text:
Thank you Xiaoyu for the incredible drinks! I ordered a mellow hot gin drink with tea and honey flavor and my husband got a spicy kavalan whiskey drink - we were not disappointed!!! So delicious! And so creative 😄
For those visiting, this bar doesn't have a cocktail menu, so you get to choose your flavors and leave the rest to the cocktail gods. It will all be worth it 📈

review_list.author: Virginie Siry
review_list.text: Super bar, we enjoyed our last night in Taipei here. My mom found this bar thanks to Google reviews and it was incredible. At first we were destabilised by the "no menu cocktail" but thanks to the nice staff who really tried to communicate with us, we were able to order some very good dirty martinis. The bartender was incredibly nice and professional. Everybody seems to have a good time there and it seems that we were the only tourists at this time. The atmosphere was so great that we decided to eat there and my risotto was tasty. Thanks at the friendly staff !

review_list.author: Yvonne
review_list.text:
What a small world 👀

人生何處不相逢😅
謝謝姐妹帶我來巡禮😘

收放自如才是高手😎調酒冠軍老闆在低調與高調中穿梭來回🤗只能說對這個好地方會一直流連忘返🍺🍷🍸🍹於是乎 ～ 初來乍到的第一晚就搞到了凌晨🕑 ……

So, 一切盡在不言中 ➡️ 來就對了‼️

Anyway , please pay attention to “ Intention ” lol …… 😶‍🌫️

review_list.author: 王繼蘅
review_list.text: Came here for New Years countdown, the staff is super friendly and accommodating. The bartenders mix customer cocktails according to each person’s preferences, they can concoct something you’ll love. The food is top tier too!

review_list.author: paul ko
review_list.text: Even though it was my last night in Taipei, I still highly recommend this place. Such a great bar with amazing cocktails and friendly bartenders—I really wish I had discovered it earlier.

review_list.author: Jasmine Ho
review_list.text: We had a wonderful night last night. The ambiance was very great and service was personal. Bar manager was funny and very welcoming. The mocktails and cocktails were tailor made to suit our taste buds. A must have experience for bar lovers. We will definitely come back.

review_list.author: Lazarus Hung
review_list.text:
無酒單的餐酒館，可以說出想要的口味（甜酸苦辣等），或是講一些稀奇古怪的主題、酒名，讓調酒師幫你依指定主題、酒名製作調酒。

像這次我們點了「哥布林」、「18公分不含頭」，前者是以苦艾酒做基底，綠色的調酒，後者則是滿滿檸檬汁酸酸的調酒。不過或許是因為主題太詭異了，味道實在是一言難盡，但仍不失為一次挺有趣的體驗。

食物部分也有一定水準。用餐離開前還會招待一杯shot。

週五、週六晚上生意很好，建議要先訂位，不過好像只能打電話訂位，沒有網路訂位，有點不太方便。

review_list.author: 劉小寶
review_list.text:
空間寬敞舒服，調酒師很健談熱情，會主動跟客人聊天。
炸物拼盤配啤酒很剛好，三杯雞義大利有點鹹很台但也很適合配生啤😂
重點是，為個人喜好出的調酒真的好喝，而且調酒師有考量女性的喜好，以酸甜但酒感不那麼明顯的調酒提供，真的很好喝！很好喝！很好喝（好喝所以強調3次）
這間是值得給5🌟好評的店家，要說小缺點大概是沒有招牌還真不好找😆

review_list.author: Becky
review_list.text:
酒跟美食都很棒！
嗨歌也超好聽，都是平常提神歌單
老闆會主持地震大家嚇到了嗎？
招待桌邊服務～喝酒～

review_list.text: 好喝的茶酒 小吃皮蛋👍

review_list.author: Ode Ho
review_list.text: 感觉很亲切感，气氛很棒，老板笑容满面，好像老朋友，我在悉尼是找不到这样的pub 给五星是理所当然的👍👍

review_list.author: Sylvia Hsu
review_list.text:
特調飲料好好喝，酒燒干貝好華麗，白醬意大利麵好吃不膩，大推！
服務人員都超熱情，是跟朋友聚餐小酌的好地方♡

review_list.author: 廖雅薇
review_list.text: I was just wandering around and decided to grab a drink, so I picked a pretty bar. Before I knew it, I'd had five! The cocktails were like works of art, and the bartender, King, meticulously explained each one. The ice and the fruit peel decorations were exquisitely crafted. I highly recommend the grilled cheese with tomato! ☺️👍👍❤️ The best part is, they were playing all my favorite songs, including The Naughty Panther on the screen! 🥹🥰🥰💕 The decor is tasteful, and the spacious indoor and outdoor areas are very comfortable. It immediately became one of my favorite places! 😆💖✨️

review_list.author: Yvonne Lin
review_list.text: I made a last-minute decision to celebrate my birthday at a bar, and this place, "Port," which I stumbled upon by chance, had the perfect atmosphere for me. The cross-cupped drink tasted so unique—it looked amazing! ♥️ I'm so happy! Happy birthday to me! 🥂

review_list.author: 廖雅薇
review_list.text:
只是亂晃想喝一杯就挑了間漂亮店，坐下來竟然就喝了5杯，調酒就像藝術品般，調酒師King也一面認真介紹酒，冰塊跟裝飾的果皮精雕細琢，吃的大推烤起司佐蕃茄☺️👍👍❤️
重點店內放的歌都是我愛的，螢幕放的是頑皮豹🥹🥰🥰💕裝潢看得出品味，室內室外空間大非常舒適，一進店裡當下立刻加入我的最愛清單😆💖✨️

review_list.author: Eva CHAO
review_list.text:
Another great place to drink in Taipei! 🤩

Port by Sphere specializes in siphon-style cocktails 🍸 They offer 10 different flavors!

For those who like sweet and sour, try No. 7 ‹ Purple Frost Leaf › Gin infused with oolong tea, apple, kumquat, and perilla.
The alcohol is light, with a rich perilla aroma ✨

For tea lovers, try No. 8 ‹ Ordinary Erguotou › Vodka blended with pu-erh tea, chamomile, and honey 🍯
The tea flavor is rich, the sweetness is moderate, and the finish is subtly sweet!

Besides cocktails, they also have fried chicken, fries, and corn chips.
They're great with drinks! 💖

The

review_list.author: 鄭翔宇
review_list.text: 氣氛很讚 酒也好喝 環境很舒服 服務也很讚👍 食物超美味

review_list.author: Yvonne Lin
review_list.text: 臨時決定在酒吧慶生，這間無意間路過的”Port”，完全是我喜歡的氛圍，交杯酒的口感很特別，會不會太好喝♥️太開心了！祝我生日快樂🥂

review_list.author: Rexxy Cap
review_list.text: This bar is similar in style to Draftland, offering pre-mixed alcoholic drinks with no real skill involved. The ambiance is Gen Z, suitable for large groups to chat. The drinks are of very low quality, and the bars in this area are generally uninspired, mostly offering quick and easy drinks. I wouldn't recommend it.

review_list.author: Eva CHAO
review_list.text:
台北喝酒好去處再加一🤩
Port by Sphere主打汲取式調酒🍸
共有10款不同的風味～
喜歡酸甜的推7號 ‹ 紫霜葉 ›
琴酒加入烏龍茶、蘋果、金桔與紫蘇
酒感輕盈可以感受到濃郁紫蘇香氣✨
愛茶酒的可以點8號 ‹ 普通洱已 ›
伏特加融合普洱茶、甘菊、蜂蜜🍯
茶味濃郁 甜度適中尾韻會微微回甘！
除了調酒外 也有炸雞、脆薯、玉米脆片等餐點
配酒一起吃超讚💖

店內環境也很質感舒適～～
有開放式沙發座位可以多人聚會
也有高腳椅區 能享受兩人獨處空間
還有一面投影幕播放火爐畫面🔥
整體氛圍非常chill 就像在家一樣的感覺☁
下班來這邊喝酒很放鬆😽

review_list.author: Lily Shi
review_list.text: Had just the most wonderful experience at the Nekko Bar. The drinks were delicious, our fav was the whisker fizz infused with shiso. The sashimi had such unique flavors with the egg yolk dipping sauce (highly recommend this dish!). But the best part was the company of the adorable cats and the staff. If you are looking for a cozy yet engaging environment then this is the spot for you!

review_list.author: 謝芽芽
review_list.text:
店內貓咪可愛
有魚系風味調酒很特別👍🏻

review_list.author: 謝芽芽
review_list.text:
店内猫咪可爱
有鱼系风味调酒很特别👍🏻

review_list.author: Elizabeth Douglas
review_list.text: This bar is so fun. The drinks are super tasty and the cats are the cutest. We were the only people in the bar and the bartender was so nice. He speaks English and he gave us churro to give to the cat.

review_list.author: 李粉圓
review_list.text:
誤打誤撞看到門口很特別就這麼走了進去，
店內座位莫約10幾個，除了一個可以坐約5-6人的小包廂，小包廂其實是貓咪的家，接著其他都是吧檯的座位，剛好一隻小貓就把吧檯變成他的展場了，在吧檯輪流走動跟展示。
店主說上周五才剛開幕（可能是頂下來的，因為看是已經有很多之前的評論），我們進去後沒多久，整間店幾乎全滿了，店主跟兩位調酒師，其中一名調酒師還是日本人，國語也算蠻能講，很靦腆，也蠻好聊天。
調酒的部分是可以特調，老板也可以依據妳的需求推薦，不過不知是否突然客人陸續變多，最後幾乎是客滿情況，以之前去過的酒吧老板都會招待特調的shot，這裡都沒有是略微可惜啦～
不過可能剛開幕，節奏還沒調整好吧～期待下一次囉！

review_list.author: Lily Shi
review_list.text: 在Nekko Bar的体验真是太棒了。饮品美味极了，我们最喜欢的是加了紫苏的Whisker Fizz。刺身搭配蛋黄酱，风味独特（强烈推荐！）。最棒的是可爱的猫咪和工作人员的陪伴。如果您正在寻找一个舒适又迷人的环境，那么这里就是您的理想之选！

review_list.author: 白善羽
review_list.text: 是以前貓吧的常客，這次是換店長以來第一次來貓吧，一進店裡就被全新的內裝吸引，從原本的沉穩變得活潑，調酒的選項變多了，第一杯點的喵賞櫻基酒使用櫻花蝦龍舌蘭，酸甜中帶有一點蝦味又不覺得突兀，十分特別很值得嘗試！餐點上建議點貓舔生魚，是店家特別醃漬過的，作為第一道菜非常開胃😌🤌

review_list.author: iris Chang
review_list.text: 餐點跟調酒都跟貓咪相關，空間很舒適舒服，還有獨立的吸煙區可以抽煙，老闆跟調酒師都很帥也會跟客人聊天，算是很親民的店，貓咪都會在店裡走來走去，喜歡貓咪跟調酒的人很推薦來看看～

review_list.author: MC CHEN
review_list.text:
The flavor of food & drink are quite unique.
It’s all about the cats❤️

review_list.author: Francisca Theo kovich
review_list.text: Foods and drinks are great. A decent place to go for small group. Their “cat boss” named Weer is so adorable. Nekko means cat in Japanese so now you know who rules the place ;) would love to come back and play with Weer again!

review_list.author: Hannah Semmes
review_list.text: Bartender Coco is the BEST! Walked in just for a drink. Ended up staying for meal, great conversation, and hand-made drinks. Great to meet you and thanks again! Hands down favorite bar in Taipei

review_list.text: 好吃

review_list.author: Joseph Lee
review_list.text: We came for alcohol during day, but it was not offered 1400 hrs FEB2026. The coffee was very good. It was very quiet, great place to have a conversation. The bar is well stocked, would return here for cocktails. Inside, it is very clean: the server spent as much time cleaning between drinks as he did making the drinks. We were impressed with how hard he worked. Impressive.

review_list.author: Joseph Lee
review_list.text: 我们白天来这里是为了喝酒，但2026年2月2日下午2点没有供应。咖啡很好喝。这里很安静，是聊天的好地方。酒吧酒水种类齐全，下次还会来喝鸡尾酒。店里非常干净：服务员在调制饮品的间隙花在清洁上的时间和调制饮品的时间一样多。他的勤奋给我们留下了深刻的印象。令人印象深刻。

review_list.author: ショウ点々
review_list.text: 以為是酒吧，想找個地方坐坐，突然瞄到咖啡，真的是很幸運，我點的是紅心芭樂咖啡跟甜點都不錯，朋友點其他的餐點都覺得很不錯，店員只有一人 很值得再來的店

review_list.author: ショウ点々
review_list.text: 以为是酒吧，想找个地方坐坐，突然瞄到咖啡，真的是很幸运，我点的是红心芭乐咖啡跟甜点都不错，朋友点其他的餐点都觉得很不错，店员只有一人 很值得再来的店

review_list.author: Tsung-Hsi Li
review_list.text: 調酒專業，調酒師會以你的需求來調，菜單也有他們的創意調酒，出酒速度快。服務親切，店內氣氛佳，適合放鬆。吃的部分略貴，但當下酒菜三五好友聚聚很適合。

review_list.author: Tsung-Hsi Li
review_list.text: 调酒专业，调酒师会以你的需求来调，菜单也有他们的创意调酒，出酒速度快。服务亲切，店内气氛佳，适合放松。吃的部分略贵，但当下酒菜三五好友聚聚很适合。

review_list.author: Nina Wang
review_list.text: 剛自德國回台，很懷念花式咖啡，在這有很多花式咖啡選擇，還有荔枝氣泡咖啡。喜歡花式咖啡的愛好者，可以來品嚐一下。

review_list.text: 精品級咖啡，高貴不貴，甜點甜而不膩，老闆帥氣又親切，還有師奶殺手級店員，超值超值，咖啡控一定會愛上！大推推推----

review_list.author: 玩世步攻
review_list.text: 精品级咖啡，高贵不贵，甜点甜而不腻，老板帅气又亲切，还有师奶杀手级店员，超值超值，咖啡控一定会爱上！大推推推----

review_list.author: Ameily
review_list.text: Went there both during the day and at night. Not a lot of people in the day, only has simple alcohol drinks like espresso martinis - great for work and study; more bustling at night with solid, creative and interesting cocktails.

review_list.author: Tiffany Tien
review_list.text: Nice environment, owner very passionate about sake and his expertise. He selects his sake really well and also tells a good story about the options. Very engaging and nice environment, you can choose to chat up other parties in the store or keep the conversation to yourself undisturbed. Would recommend this sake bar to all visiting taipei.

review_list.author: 馬可石
review_list.text: 全台最大杯120 ml~ 老闆推薦的清酒都很好喝，還會分享每支清酒的小故事哦😉

review_list.author: Manson hsu
review_list.text:
專業的老闆
佛心、大心、暖心
值得一來，我酒量不好，一組清酒set ，三杯微醺走回家剛好。
第一杯 四選一
第二杯 二選一
第三杯 固定

店面不大，但很溫暖，音樂很好，老闆不打擾，不會要硬聊，若你要跟他聊，他也會跟你聊。

所以一個人也好，三人也罷，可試試這大叔酒吧！👍

今天兩組+三個小菜（都好吃），一條明太子吃起來好開心！

review_list.author: Daryn Huang
review_list.text: 老闆很幽默也很懂酒，可以喝到在台灣少見的日本酒。內部不大，反而更有舒適親近的感覺。值得再來。

review_list.author: TSANG Tsing
review_list.text: Very good sake bar if you visit Taipei, a large variety of sake to choose, from sake by glass or a whole bottle.

1.The food is subtly flavored, with a light and refined taste rather than anything overpowering.
2.Sake recommendations are highly professional, with clear and

review_list.author: Kate Shao
review_list.text:
Loved the chill and cozy vibe here — the lighting was dim but in a nice way. They served a cup of rich Japanese chicken soup when we sat down, which was such a nice surprise and super tasty.

But I made the mistake of not having dinner beforehand — the portions were pretty small, more like snacks or sides that go well with drinks. It would be great if the staff could remind customers about the portion size.

Everything seemed freshly made, so some dishes took a while to come out (sometimes over 30 minutes), but the quality made it worth the wait.

Their sake selection was amazing! We picked on

review_list.author: Jolin Tsai
review_list.text:
真的是從空間到餐點、再到清酒搭配都讓人滿意。我們8人用餐，為我們準備了獨立很舒適的包廂空間，藤編拉門、柔黃燈光、木質桌椅，坐下馬上有安心感
一整晚聊天也不怕太吵或太開放，非常適合朋友聚會或小團體小酌
.
澳洲和牛橫隔膜：肉片切得厚薄適中，油脂分佈漂亮，入口先有肉香、再帶微微炙燒焦香，咀嚼中吃得到和牛的那份柔嫩與甘甜感
柚子胡椒海草乳酪偽燉飯：外觀像燉飯但口感輕盈，乳酪滑順伴隨淡淡海草鹹味與柚子胡椒的活潑辛香，比預期的更清爽
鰹魚酒盜焦化奶油義大利麵：麵條滑潤，奶油基底濃郁但不膩，鰹魚酒盜的鹹香和焦化香氣跳出來，讓整體味道有點驚喜，配上奶油麵真的特別
鹽麴豬五花搭巴西里洋蔥醬：豬五花先以鹽麴醃過，肉質保留彈性，鹹味柔和帶麴香；搭配巴西里洋蔥醬讓味道更清爽，洋蔥的微甜與香草味化解了五花的油膩
烤山藥搭明太子奶油醬：這道我們點了兩次。山藥烤過外層微脆、內部仍保有山藥的黏滑感，濃郁明太子奶油醬，鹹香奶香融合山藥清甜，整道讓人停不了嘴
.
我們請店員推薦了三支清酒
夏の流れ星：入口清爽，帶淡淡果香和米香，尾韻柔和但留有一絲酒氣
OCEAN99 純米吟釀 青海：酒體稍微厚實一些，但不會太過，仍然保水果般的風味，很特別保有香濃清爽的風味
吾有事 純米大吟釀 雲の上：這支層次感最明顯，先是清雅的花果香，再轉為柔和米甜，酒精感不強卻存在感足，非常適合配餐後段，慢慢品
.
整晚的節奏從開胃小點＋清酒暖

review_list.author: Yayi Chen
review_list.text: All the sake options, food, interior design are a very good combination and super comfy to hang out with your good friends. Most important of all you can stay as long as you want, so better make reservations as early as possible

review_list.author: Joss Su
review_list.text:
可能因為是清酒專賣店，所以調酒很普通。
餐點部份偏量少，口味普通。

這是我第一次去餐酒館用餐後，卻沒有任何一道是讓我覺得特別驚艷好吃的。
但鴨肉火鍋肉量給得還可以👍🏻

可能因為來以前看了評論說很好吃，所以滿期待的，但實際卻令人感到失望⋯

店家客氣有禮貌，店內雖小但氛圍還可以，其他沒什麼特別的記憶點。
想喝清酒的可以去去看，店家冰箱櫃滿滿的各式清酒可供選擇🍶

review_list.author: Dory Rotti
review_list.text:
久違的回台灣，一直在看評價找 “真的“ 好吃的餐廳！！ 最終選擇了這家，真的是太幸運了！

食物每一個味道都非常的美味跟多層次，都是很適合配酒的下酒味。。！

帥氣年輕的老闆親自推薦了很多好吃的，每一道都有眼睛發亮的感覺！

價格也都在合理範圍內！

酒品真的多到不知道怎麼選。。。每一瓶都想喝一口 🤣🤣🤣

我們選了一隻酒體比較厚的很好喝，就是可惜食物比較重口味，如果選了清爽一點的清酒，感覺會更搭！

下次要去試試 ”氣泡清酒“ 聽起來就非常特別！😆😆😆

老闆還介紹喝了一款帶蘋果味的清酒？可能太醉了，都不記得味道了！但很開心可依嘗試不同的清酒！

喔對！他們招待的開胃昆布雞湯也好好喝唷！！！真是照顧客人的胃！😆😆😆

review_list.author: Jerry Hsu
review_list.text: Wonderful drinks and food, with an impressive selection of sake. I’ll definitely be back to try more.

review_list.author: NaNa T
review_list.text:
店內氛圍很好，食物很精緻好吃
大推山藥、生蠔
燉飯、義大利麵也很推
且他們家的清酒雖然價位不算便宜，但老闆很會選酒，店員推的每隻清酒都很喜歡，店員很專業
喜歡喝清酒的千萬不要錯過這家

review_list.author: inky inky
review_list.text:
每道餐點都有其特色
今天來慶生的老闆很親切服務非常之好
還拿了許多酒來跟我們分享
是專門的清酒吧，推推

菜色感受出來用心製作

很適合約會跟慶生呦！

review_list.author: Molly Yeh
review_list.text: Great time w friends, owner is nice and knows abt sake!  Food is pretty good too

review_list.author: Jennifer Kang
review_list.text: Such a lovely spot! Good food with friendly service. Staff are ever happy to recommend food or sake. You start off with a complimentary cup of chicken soup- so yummy! And, finish off with a free shot with the sake guru when you pay the bill!

review_list.text: 緋洛醚亞鎮 Philomia Town bar, 店內裝潢很有萬聖節特色的bar,選酒是用遊戲方式,也能點單杯,有飛鏢能玩,店內服務人員也會適時幫忙炒熱氣氛,附帶的情緒價值拉到滿耶!

review_list.author: David Wang
review_list.text: Great bar - a must try! I would preference this bar over many of the other better known bars around the area. The cocktails are not just for show; they're incredibly well made. Vibe is very chill. The theming is on point.

review_list.author: Alice C
review_list.text: I absolutely loved the bar's atmosphere, with its charming witchy vibe. The cocktails were not only delicious but also beautifully presented. I highly recommend this spot for anyone seeking a unique experience!

review_list.author: Ming
review_list.text:
店內的裝潢很吸睛，不同的酒也會搭配不同的主題，店員很好聊，如果喜歡熱鬧的氛圍，一個人去也不會尷尬
小潘還教了我們很多喝酒遊戲🤣
可惜自己酒量不夠好，喝兩杯就跑去外面吐了哈哈哈੭ ᐕ)੭
有一位漂亮的女店員還貼心的出來陪著我🫶🏻
讓人感到賓至如歸的店，真的太讚啦
下次有機會再去體驗新酒單😎

review_list.author: Andrew Voda
review_list.text: EASILY the best bar in Taipei. The staff is friendly and speak both English and Mandarin. The drinks are a work of art and Instagram-worthy. This is a hidden gem and you're lucky to find it!!

review_list.author: Vivi Zhu
review_list.text: 裝潢是中世紀的英式風格。牆上有騎士盔甲、火炬，菜單設計很特別，很有古世紀的味道。每杯酒的裝飾都很獨一無二，口感也很特別。店員很親切，也會跟客人一起玩射飛鏢，請喝shot。
